--!nolint
-- executor compatibility (Delta, Potassium, Wave, Xeno, Solara, etc.): fill in anything the executor lacks
do
    local env = (type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
    local exe = "unknown"
    pcall(function() if identifyexecutor then exe = tostring((identifyexecutor())) end end)
    env.EtherealExecutor = exe
    local store = {}
    if not env.writefile then env.writefile = function(n, c) store[n] = c end end
    if not env.readfile then env.readfile = function(n) return store[n] or error("no file") end end
    if not env.isfile then env.isfile = function(n) return store[n] ~= nil end end
    if not env.makefolder then env.makefolder = function() end end
    if not env.isfolder then env.isfolder = function() return true end end
    if not env.newcclosure then env.newcclosure = function(f) return f end end
    if not env.checkcaller then env.checkcaller = function() return false end end
    if not env.cloneref then env.cloneref = function(x) return x end end
    if not env.mouse1click then
        env.mouse1click = function()
            local VIM = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
            local c = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize / 2
            VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(c.X, c.Y, 0, true, game, 0)
            VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(c.X, c.Y, 0, false, game, 0)
        end
    end
    for _, n in ipairs({ "writefile", "readfile", "isfile", "makefolder", "isfolder", "newcclosure", "checkcaller", "cloneref", "mouse1click" }) do
        if rawget(_G, n) == nil and env[n] ~= nil then pcall(function() _G[n] = env[n] end) end
    end
end
do
    local P = game:GetService("Players")
    while not P.LocalPlayer do task.wait() end
end
warn("[ethereal] executing")
if getgenv().vercel_unload then pcall(getgenv().vercel_unload) end
getgenv().vercel_unload = nil
getgenv().vercel_loaded = true
local __ok, __err = xpcall(function()
warn("[ethereal] starting")

-- ethereal | premium
local SOURCE = [==========[
local InputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local function genv()
    if type(getgenv) == "function" then return getgenv() end
    return _G
end
do
    local old = genv().Vercel_Library
    if type(old) == "table" and old.IsVercel then
        pcall(function() if old.Unload then old:Unload() end end)
    end
end
local ProtectGui = protectgui or (syn and syn.protect_gui) or function() end

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
pcall(ProtectGui, ScreenGui)
ScreenGui.Name = "EtherealUI"
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.DisplayOrder = 100
ScreenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
if not pcall(function() ScreenGui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or CoreGui end) and not pcall(function() ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui end) then
    ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local Toggles, Options = {}, {}

local Library = {
    IsVercel = true, Name = "Vercel", Toggles = Toggles, Options = Options, ScreenGui = ScreenGui,
    FontColor = Color3.fromRGB(236, 236, 241),
    MainColor = Color3.fromRGB(23, 24, 30),
    BackgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(13, 14, 18),
    AccentColor = Color3.fromRGB(226, 84, 92),
    OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(40, 41, 50),
    RiskColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70),
    Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, FontBold = Enum.Font.GothamBold, FontSize = 13,
    Toggled = false, LockUI = false,
    UseDarken = false, DarkenAmount = 40, UseBlur = false, BlurSize = 18,
    ToggleKeybind = { Type = "KeyPicker", Value = "RightShift" },
    FontFaces = {}, Signals = {}, Reg = {}, UnloadCallbacks = {},
}
for _, n in ipairs({ "Gotham", "GothamMedium", "Code", "SourceSans", "Ubuntu", "Arial", "Roboto", "RobotoMono", "Nunito" }) do
    pcall(function() if Enum.Font[n] then Library.FontFaces[n] = Enum.Font[n] end end)
end
pcall(function() if not Enum.Font.GothamBold then Library.FontBold = Library.Font end end)
Library.AccentColorDark = Color3.new(Library.AccentColor.R * 0.6, Library.AccentColor.G * 0.6, Library.AccentColor.B * 0.6)

function Library:GetDarkerColor(c) return Color3.new(c.R * 0.6, c.G * 0.6, c.B * 0.6) end
function Library:Dim() return Library.FontColor:Lerp(Library.BackgroundColor, 0.58) end
function Library:Off() return Library.OutlineColor:Lerp(Library.FontColor, 0.1) end
function Library:Card() return Library.MainColor:Lerp(Library.BackgroundColor, 0.45) end
local function reg(fn) Library.Reg[#Library.Reg + 1] = fn pcall(fn) return fn end
function Library:UpdateColorsUsingRegistry()
    Library.AccentColorDark = Library:GetDarkerColor(Library.AccentColor)
    for _, fn in ipairs(Library.Reg) do pcall(fn) end
end
local function connect(sig, fn)
    local c = sig:Connect(fn)
    Library.Signals[#Library.Signals + 1] = c
    return c
end
local function tween(o, t, props)
    pcall(function() TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props):Play() end)
end

local function new(class, props, parent)
    local o = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do o[k] = v end
    if parent then o.Parent = parent end
    return o
end
local function corner(o, r) return new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r) }, o) end
local function stroke(o, getc, th)
    local s = new("UIStroke", { Thickness = th or 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, o)
    reg(function() s.Color = getc and getc() or Library.OutlineColor end)
    return s
end
local function bg(o, getc) reg(function() o.BackgroundColor3 = getc() end) end
local function text(parent, props, kind)
    local t = new("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, nil)
    for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do t[k] = v end
    local off = (kind == "small" and -1) or (kind == "head" and 1) or 0
    reg(function()
        t.Font = (kind == "head" or kind == "title") and Library.FontBold or Library.Font
        t.TextSize = Library.FontSize + off
        t.TextColor3 = (kind == "dim" or kind == "small") and Library:Dim() or Library.FontColor
    end)
    t.Parent = parent
    return t
end
local order = 0
local function nextOrder() order = order + 1 return order end

local function dragBar(hit, bar, cb)
    local dragging = false
    local function upd(x)
        local a = math.clamp((x - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
        cb(a)
    end
    connect(hit.InputBegan, function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            upd(i.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    connect(InputService.InputChanged, function(i)
        if dragging and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then upd(i.Position.X) end
    end)
    connect(InputService.InputEnded, function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
    end)
end

-- ===== vector icons built from frames (no image assets needed) =====
local function bar(parent, x, y, w, h, rot, circle)
    local f = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), BorderSizePixel = 0, Rotation = rot or 0 }, parent)
    if circle then corner(f, 100) end
    return f
end
local function ring(parent, x, y, d, th)
    local f = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, parent)
    corner(f, 100)
    local s = new("UIStroke", { Thickness = th or 1.5 }, f)
    return f, s
end
local function makeIcon(parent, kind)
    local box = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, parent)
    local fills, strokes = {}, {}
    local holeRef
    local function F(f) fills[#fills + 1] = f return f end
    local function S(pair) strokes[#strokes + 1] = pair[2] return pair[1] end
    if kind == "grid" then
        for _, p in ipairs({ { 5, 5 }, { 13, 5 }, { 5, 13 }, { 13, 13 } }) do corner(F(bar(box, p[1], p[2], 7, 7)), 2) end
    elseif kind == "crosshair" then
        S({ ring(box, 9, 9, 12, 1.5) })
        F(bar(box, 9, 1.5, 1.5, 4)) F(bar(box, 9, 16.5, 1.5, 4)) F(bar(box, 1.5, 9, 4, 1.5)) F(bar(box, 16.5, 9, 4, 1.5))
        F(bar(box, 9, 9, 3, 3, 0, true))
    elseif kind == "chevrons" then
        for _, cx in ipairs({ 6, 12 }) do
            F(bar(box, cx, 6, 8, 2, 45)) F(bar(box, cx, 12, 8, 2, -45))
        end
    elseif kind == "sliders" then
        for i, y in ipairs({ 4, 9, 14 }) do F(bar(box, 9, y, 16, 1.5)) end
        for _, k in ipairs({ { 5, 4 }, { 12, 9 }, { 7, 14 } }) do F(bar(box, k[1], k[2], 5, 5, 0, true)) end
    elseif kind == "eye" then
        local e, s = ring(box, 9, 9, 10, 1.5)
        e.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 11)
        strokes[#strokes + 1] = s
        F(bar(box, 9, 9, 5, 5, 0, true))
    elseif kind == "diamond" then
        local d, s = ring(box, 9, 9, 10, 1.5)
        corner(d, 2) d.Rotation = 45
        strokes[#strokes + 1] = s
        F(bar(box, 9, 9, 3, 3, 0, true))
    elseif kind == "gear" then
        for _, r in ipairs({ 0, 45, 90, 135 }) do F(bar(box, 9, 9, 3, 17, r)) end
        F(bar(box, 9, 9, 11, 11, 0, true))
        holeRef = bar(box, 9, 9, 5, 5, 0, true)
    elseif kind == "search" then
        S({ ring(box, 8, 8, 10, 1.5) }) F(bar(box, 14, 14, 6, 1.6, 45))
    elseif kind == "arrow" then
        F(bar(box, 6, 9, 8, 1.8, 45)) F(bar(box, 12, 9, 8, 1.8, -45))
    else
        S({ ring(box, 9, 9, 12, 1.5) })
    end
    local icon = { Frame = box }
    function icon:SetColor(c, holeColor)
        for _, f in ipairs(fills) do f.BackgroundColor3 = c end
        for _, s in ipairs(strokes) do s.Color = c end
        if holeRef then holeRef.BackgroundColor3 = holeColor or Library.BackgroundColor end
    end
    return icon
end
local KIND_BY_NAME = { main = "grid", combat = "crosshair", movement = "chevrons", utilities = "sliders", visuals = "eye", extras = "diamond", settings = "gear", skins = "diamond" }

-- ===== notifications =====
local NotifyHolder = new("Frame", { Name = "Notify", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 14), Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 1, -28), ZIndex = 200 }, ScreenGui)
new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, NotifyHolder)
function Library:Notify(msg, dur)
    pcall(function()
        local f = new("Frame", { AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = nextOrder(), ZIndex = 200 }, NotifyHolder)
        bg(f, function() return Library.MainColor end)
        corner(f, 10) stroke(f)
        local accent = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, -12), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 201 }, f)
        corner(accent, 2) bg(accent, function() return Library.AccentColor end)
        new("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 18), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 14), PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 9), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 9) }, f)
        local t = text(f, { Text = tostring(msg), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), ZIndex = 201 })
        task.delay(tonumber(dur) or 3, function()
            pcall(function()
                tween(f, 0.25, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
                tween(t, 0.25, { TextTransparency = 1 })
                task.wait(0.3) f:Destroy()
            end)
        end)
    end)
end
function Library:AddToolTip() end

-- ===== controls =====
local GB = {}
GB.__index = GB

local function newRow(self, h, label)
    local r = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h), LayoutOrder = nextOrder() }, self.Body)
    corner(r, 7)
    if h == 0 then r.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y end
    self.Rows[#self.Rows + 1] = { frame = r, text = tostring(label or ""):lower() }
    return r
end
local function hover(r, hit)
    connect(hit.MouseEnter, function() tween(r, 0.12, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.95 }) end)
    connect(hit.MouseLeave, function() tween(r, 0.12, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }) end)
end
local function fmt(v, r)
    if (r or 0) <= 0 then return tostring(math.floor(v + 0.5)) end
    return string.format("%." .. r .. "f", v)
end

function GB:AddToggle(idx, info)
    info = info or {}
    local t = { Value = info.Default and true or false, Type = "Toggle", Changed = {}, Text = info.Text or tostring(idx) }
    local r = newRow(self, 28, info.Text or idx)
    local lbl = text(r, { Text = info.Text or tostring(idx), Size = UDim2.new(1, -44, 1, 0) })
    local sw = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 16), BorderSizePixel = 0 }, r)
    corner(sw, 8)
    local knob = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12), BorderSizePixel = 0 }, sw)
    corner(knob, 6)
    local function render(instant)
        local on = t.Value
        local sc = on and Library.AccentColor or Library:Off()
        local kc = on and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Library:Dim()
        local kp = on and UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0)
        if instant then sw.BackgroundColor3 = sc knob.BackgroundColor3 = kc knob.Position = kp
        else tween(sw, 0.15, { BackgroundColor3 = sc }) tween(knob, 0.15, { BackgroundColor3 = kc, Position = kp }) end
        lbl.TextColor3 = on and Library.FontColor or Library.FontColor:Lerp(Library.BackgroundColor, 0.2)
    end
    reg(function() render(true) end)
    local hit = new("TextButton", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 3 }, r)
    hover(r, hit)
    local keyBtn = new("TextButton", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -38, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 16), BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Visible = false, ZIndex = 6 }, r)
    corner(keyBtn, 5) bg(keyBtn, function() return Library.MainColor end)
    local keyTxt = text(keyBtn, { Text = "[ ]", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = 7 }, "small")
    reg(function() keyTxt.TextColor3 = Library.AccentColor keyTxt.TextSize = 10 end)
    local function paintKey()
        keyTxt.Text = t.Key and ("[" .. t.Key .. "]") or "[ ]"
        keyBtn.Visible = t.Key ~= nil or Library.Listening == t
    end
    function t:SetKey(k) t.Key = k paintKey() end
    connect(hit.MouseButton2Click, function()
        Library.Listening = t
        keyTxt.Text = "..."
        keyBtn.Visible = true
    end)
    connect(keyBtn.MouseButton1Click, function() Library.Listening = nil t:SetKey(nil) end)
    t._paintKey = paintKey
    function t:SetValue(v)
        v = v and true or false
        local changed = v ~= self.Value
        self.Value = v
        render()
        if changed then
            if info.Callback then task.spawn(info.Callback, v) end
            for _, f in ipairs(self.Changed) do task.spawn(f, v) end
        end
    end
    function t:OnChanged(f) self.Changed[#self.Changed + 1] = f end
    connect(hit.MouseButton1Click, function() t:SetValue(not t.Value) end)
    Toggles[idx] = t
    return t
end

function GB:AddSlider(idx, info)
    info = info or {}
    local min, max, rnd = info.Min or 0, info.Max or 100, info.Rounding or 0
    local s = { Value = info.Default or min, Min = min, Max = max, Type = "Slider", Changed = {} }
    local r = newRow(self, 28, info.Text or idx)
    text(r, { Text = info.Text or tostring(idx), Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 1, 0), TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd })
    local val = new("TextBox", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.62, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.14, 0, 1, 0), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, ClearTextOnFocus = true, BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = "", ZIndex = 4 }, r)
    reg(function() val.Font = Library.Font val.TextSize = Library.FontSize - 1 val.TextColor3 = Library:Dim() end)
    local hit = new("TextButton", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.36, 0, 1, 0), ZIndex = 3 }, r)
    hover(r, hit)
    local track = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 8), BorderSizePixel = 0 }, hit)
    corner(track, 4)
    local fill = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0 }, track)
    corner(fill, 4)
    local grad = new("UIGradient", {}, fill)
    local knob = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 12), BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) }, track)
    corner(knob, 3)
    local function render()
        local a = (max > min) and math.clamp((s.Value - min) / (max - min), 0, 1) or 0
        fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(a, 1)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(a, a > 0.5 and -2 or 2, 0.5, 0)
        val.Text = fmt(s.Value, rnd) .. (info.Suffix or "")
        track.BackgroundColor3 = Library:Off()
        fill.BackgroundColor3 = Library.AccentColor
        grad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Library.AccentColor:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.25), Library.AccentColor)
    end
    reg(render)
    function s:SetValue(v, silent)
        v = tonumber(v) or min
        local m = 10 ^ rnd
        v = math.clamp(math.floor(v * m + 0.5) / m, min, max)
        local changed = v ~= self.Value
        self.Value = v
        render()
        if changed and not silent then
            if info.Callback then task.spawn(info.Callback, v) end
            for _, f in ipairs(self.Changed) do task.spawn(f, v) end
        end
    end
    function s:OnChanged(f) self.Changed[#self.Changed + 1] = f end
    dragBar(hit, track, function(a) s:SetValue(min + (max - min) * a) end)
    connect(val.FocusLost, function()
        local n = tonumber((val.Text:gsub("[^%d%.%-]", "")))
        if n then s:SetValue(n) else render() end
    end)
    Options[idx] = s
    return s
end

function GB:AddDropdown(idx, info)
    info = info or {}
    local d = { Values = info.Values or {}, Type = "Dropdown", Changed = {}, Value = nil }
    local r = newRow(self, 0, info.Text or idx)
    new("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 2), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4) }, r)
    new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 5), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, r)
    text(r, { Text = info.Text or tostring(idx), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16), LayoutOrder = 1 }, "small")
    local box = new("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, LayoutOrder = 2 }, r)
    corner(box, 6) bg(box, function() return Library.MainColor end)
    local bs = stroke(box)
    local cur = text(box, { Text = "", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0) })
    local chev = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, box)
    local c1 = bar(chev, 4.5, 7, 7, 1.8, 45)
    local c2 = bar(chev, 9.5, 7, 7, 1.8, -45)
    reg(function() c1.BackgroundColor3 = Library:Dim() c2.BackgroundColor3 = Library:Dim() end)
    local list = new("Frame", { Visible = false, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = 3 }, r)
    corner(list, 8) stroke(list) bg(list, function() return Library.MainColor end)
    new("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, list)
    new("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4) }, list)
    local items = {}
    local function paint()
        cur.Text = tostring(d.Value or "")
        for v, b in pairs(items) do
            local on = v == d.Value
            b.TextColor3 = on and Library.AccentColor or Library.FontColor:Lerp(Library.BackgroundColor, 0.2)
            b.BackgroundColor3 = Library.AccentColor
            b.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0.88 or 1
            b.Font = Library.Font
            b.TextSize = Library.FontSize
        end
    end
    reg(paint)
    local function rebuild()
        for _, b in pairs(items) do b:Destroy() end
        items = {}
        for i, v in ipairs(d.Values) do
            local b = new("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26), BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = "  " .. tostring(v), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, AutoButtonColor = false, LayoutOrder = i }, list)
            corner(b, 6)
            items[v] = b
            connect(b.MouseButton1Click, function() d:SetValue(v) list.Visible = false chev.Rotation = 0 end)
        end
        paint()
    end
    function d:SetValue(v, silent)
        if type(v) == "number" and self.Values[v] ~= nil and type(self.Values[1]) ~= "number" then v = self.Values[v] end
        local changed = v ~= self.Value
        self.Value = v
        paint()
        if changed and not silent then
            if info.Callback then task.spawn(info.Callback, v) end
            for _, f in ipairs(self.Changed) do task.spawn(f, v) end
        end
    end
    function d:SetValues(vals)
        self.Values = vals or {}
        if self.Value == nil or not table.find(self.Values, self.Value) then self.Value = self.Values[1] end
        rebuild()
    end
    function d:OnChanged(f) self.Changed[#self.Changed + 1] = f end
    local def = info.Default
    if type(def) == "number" then d.Value = d.Values[def] elseif def ~= nil then d.Value = def else d.Value = d.Values[1] end
    rebuild()
    connect(box.MouseButton1Click, function() list.Visible = not list.Visible tween(chev, 0.15, { Rotation = list.Visible and 180 or 0 }) end)
    connect(box.MouseEnter, function() bs.Color = Library.AccentColor end)
    connect(box.MouseLeave, function() bs.Color = Library.OutlineColor end)
    Options[idx] = d
    return d
end

function GB:AddButton(info, func)
    if type(info) == "string" then info = { Text = info, Func = func } end
    info = info or {}
    local r = newRow(self, 36, info.Text)
    local b = new("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 3), BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = info.Text or "Button", AutoButtonColor = false }, r)
    corner(b, 6) bg(b, function() return Library.MainColor end)
    local bs = stroke(b)
    local g = new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90 }, b)
    reg(function()
        b.Font = Library.Font b.TextSize = Library.FontSize b.TextColor3 = Library.FontColor
        g.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
    end)
    connect(b.MouseEnter, function() bs.Color = Library.AccentColor tween(b, 0.12, { TextColor3 = Library.AccentColor }) end)
    connect(b.MouseLeave, function() bs.Color = Library.OutlineColor tween(b, 0.12, { TextColor3 = Library.FontColor }) end)
    connect(b.MouseButton1Down, function() tween(b, 0.06, { Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 28), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 4) }) end)
    connect(b.MouseButton1Up, function() tween(b, 0.1, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 3) }) end)
    connect(b.MouseButton1Click, function()
        local f = info.Func or info.Callback
        if f then task.spawn(f) end
    end)
    local o = { gb = self }
    function o:SetText(t) b.Text = t end
    function o:AddButton(i2, f2) return GB.AddButton(self.gb, i2, f2) end
    return o
end

function GB:AddLabel(txt, wrap)
    local r = newRow(self, 0, txt)
    local l = text(r, { Text = tostring(txt), Size = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, TextWrapped = true, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top }, "dim")
    new("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 5) }, l)
    local o = {}
    function o:SetText(t) l.Text = tostring(t) end
    function o:AddColorPicker(idx, info)
        info = info or {}
        local cp = { Value = info.Default or Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Type = "ColorPicker", Changed = {} }
        l.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
        l.Size = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0, 32)
        l.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
        r.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
        r.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34)
        l.TextColor3 = Library.FontColor
        local sw = new("TextButton", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 6), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 22), BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false }, r)
        corner(sw, 11) stroke(sw, function() return Library.FontColor end)
        local pop = new("Frame", { Visible = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 72), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 38), BorderSizePixel = 0 }, r)
        local bars = {}
        local function apply()
            sw.BackgroundColor3 = cp.Value
            local v = cp.Value
            local rgb = { v.R, v.G, v.B }
            for i = 1, 3 do bars[i].Size = UDim2.fromScale(rgb[i], 1) end
        end
        local tints = { Color3.fromRGB(235, 70, 70), Color3.fromRGB(70, 210, 110), Color3.fromRGB(80, 140, 255) }
        for i = 1, 3 do
            local hit = new("TextButton", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, (i - 1) * 24), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22) }, pop)
            local tr = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 6), BorderSizePixel = 0 }, hit)
            corner(tr, 3) bg(tr, function() return Library:Off() end)
            local fill = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = tints[i] }, tr)
            corner(fill, 3)
            bars[i] = fill
            dragBar(hit, tr, function(a)
                local v = cp.Value
                local rgb = { v.R, v.G, v.B }
                rgb[i] = a
                cp:SetValue(Color3.new(rgb[1], rgb[2], rgb[3]))
            end)
        end
        function cp:SetValue(c)
            self.Value = c
            apply()
            if info.Callback then task.spawn(info.Callback, c) end
            for _, f in ipairs(self.Changed) do task.spawn(f, c) end
        end
        function cp:SetValueRGB(c) self:SetValue(c) end
        function cp:OnChanged(f) self.Changed[#self.Changed + 1] = f end
        connect(sw.MouseButton1Click, function()
            pop.Visible = not pop.Visible
            r.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, pop.Visible and 114 or 34)
        end)
        apply()
        Options[idx] = cp
        return cp
    end
    function o:AddKeyPicker() return {} end
    return o
end

function GB:AddInput(idx, info)
    info = info or {}
    local o = { Value = info.Default or "", Type = "Input", Changed = {} }
    local r = newRow(self, 0, info.Text or idx)
    new("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 2), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4) }, r)
    new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 5), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, r)
    text(r, { Text = info.Text or tostring(idx), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16), LayoutOrder = 1 }, "small")
    local tb = new("TextBox", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = o.Value, PlaceholderText = info.Placeholder or "", ClearTextOnFocus = false, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = 2 }, r)
    corner(tb, 6) bg(tb, function() return Library.MainColor end)
    local ts = stroke(tb)
    new("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12) }, tb)
    reg(function() tb.Font = Library.Font tb.TextSize = Library.FontSize tb.TextColor3 = Library.FontColor tb.PlaceholderColor3 = Library:Dim() end)
    connect(tb.Focused, function() ts.Color = Library.AccentColor end)
    function o:SetValue(v) self.Value = tostring(v or "") tb.Text = self.Value end
    function o:OnChanged(f) self.Changed[#self.Changed + 1] = f end
    connect(tb.FocusLost, function()
        ts.Color = Library.OutlineColor
        o.Value = tb.Text
        if info.Callback then task.spawn(info.Callback, o.Value) end
        for _, f in ipairs(o.Changed) do task.spawn(f, o.Value) end
    end)
    Options[idx] = o
    return o
end

function GB:AddBlank(h) newRow(self, h or 6, "") end

    bg(l, function() return Library.OutlineColor end)
end

local DarkOverlay = new("Frame", { Name = "Dark", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, Active = false }, ScreenGui)
local ModalBtn = new("TextButton", { Text = "", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), Modal = false }, ScreenGui)
Library.DarkOverlay = DarkOverlay

function Library:UpdateEffects()
    DarkOverlay.Visible = Library.Toggled and Library.UseDarken
    DarkOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(Library.DarkenAmount / 100, 0, 1)
    if Library.UseBlur and Library.Toggled then
        if not Library.Blur then Library.Blur = new("BlurEffect", { Name = "VercelBlur", Size = 0 }, Lighting) end
        Library.Blur.Size = Library.BlurSize
        Library.Blur.Enabled = true
    elseif Library.Blur then
        Library.Blur.Enabled = false
    end
end
function Library:Toggle()
    Library.Toggled = not Library.Toggled
    if Library.Outer then
        Library.Outer.Visible = Library.Toggled
        if Library.Toggled and Library.Scale then
            Library.Scale.Scale = (Library.BaseScale or 1) * 0.93
            tween(Library.Scale, 0.2, { Scale = Library.BaseScale or 1 })
        end
    end
    pcall(function() ModalBtn.Modal = Library.Toggled end)
    Library:UpdateEffects()
end
function Library:SetFontFace(name) Library.Font = Library.FontFaces[name] or Library.Font Library:UpdateColorsUsingRegistry() end
function Library:SetFontSize(n) Library.FontSize = tonumber(n) or 13 Library:UpdateColorsUsingRegistry() end
function Library:AddDarkenSlider(box)
    box:AddToggle("VercelDarken", { Text = "Darken background", Default = Library.UseDarken, Callback = function(v) Library.UseDarken = v Library:UpdateEffects() end })
    box:AddSlider("VercelDarkenAmt", { Text = "Darken amount", Default = Library.DarkenAmount, Min = 0, Max = 90, Rounding = 0, Callback = function(v) Library.DarkenAmount = v Library:UpdateEffects() end })
end
function Library:AddBlurSlider(box)
    box:AddToggle("VercelBlur", { Text = "Background blur", Default = Library.UseBlur, Callback = function(v) Library.UseBlur = v Library:UpdateEffects() end })
    box:AddSlider("VercelBlurAmt", { Text = "Blur amount", Default = Library.BlurSize, Min = 0, Max = 56, Rounding = 0, Callback = function(v) Library.BlurSize = v Library:UpdateEffects() end })
end

Library.ThemePresets = {
    Ember = { AccentColor = Color3.fromRGB(226, 84, 92), FontColor = Color3.fromRGB(236, 236, 241), MainColor = Color3.fromRGB(23, 24, 30), BackgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(13, 14, 18), OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(40, 41, 50) },
    Gold = { AccentColor = Color3.fromRGB(184, 134, 63), FontColor = Color3.fromRGB(245, 236, 220), MainColor = Color3.fromRGB(18, 17, 17), BackgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(3, 4, 8), OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(58, 46, 30) },
    Ethereal = { AccentColor = Color3.fromRGB(226, 84, 92), FontColor = Color3.fromRGB(236, 236, 241), MainColor = Color3.fromRGB(23, 24, 30), BackgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(13, 14, 18), OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(226, 213, 190) },
    Heaven = { AccentColor = Color3.fromRGB(240, 178, 62), FontColor = Color3.fromRGB(48, 62, 98), MainColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), BackgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(226, 240, 255), OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(196, 214, 240) },
    Cloud = { AccentColor = Color3.fromRGB(96, 170, 255), FontColor = Color3.fromRGB(48, 62, 98), MainColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), BackgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(238, 244, 252), OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(208, 220, 238) },
    Sunrise = { AccentColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 110), FontColor = Color3.fromRGB(88, 60, 70), MainColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 252, 250), BackgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 232, 220), OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(240, 208, 196) },
    Midnight = { AccentColor = Color3.fromRGB(150, 118, 255), FontColor = Color3.fromRGB(238, 238, 244), MainColor = Color3.fromRGB(19, 19, 25), BackgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(9, 9, 12), OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 50) },
}
function Library:GetThemePresetNames()
    local n = {}
    for k in pairs(Library.ThemePresets) do n[#n + 1] = k end
    table.sort(n)
    return n
end
function Library:ApplyThemePreset(name)
    local p = Library.ThemePresets[name]
    if not p then return false end
    for k, v in pairs(p) do Library[k] = v end
    Library:UpdateColorsUsingRegistry()
    return true
end


local UL_B64 = ""
local function decodeB64(b64)
    local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    local lut = {}
    for i = 1, #alphabet do lut[alphabet:byte(i)] = i - 1 end
    local out, n = {}, 0
    for i = 1, #b64, 4 do
        local a, b, c, d = b64:byte(i, i + 3)
        local v = (lut[a] or 0) * 262144 + (lut[b] or 0) * 4096 + ((c and lut[c]) or 0) * 64 + ((d and lut[d]) or 0)
        n = n + 1
        local b1, b2, b3 = math.floor(v / 65536) % 256, math.floor(v / 256) % 256, v % 256
        if not c or c == 61 then out[n] = string.char(b1)
        elseif not d or d == 61 then out[n] = string.char(b1, b2)
        else out[n] = string.char(b1, b2, b3) end
        if n % 4000 == 0 then task.wait() end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end
local function putAsset(name, b64)
    if not (writefile and getcustomasset) then return nil end
    pcall(function() if not isfolder("ethereal") then makefolder("ethereal") end end)
    local path = "ethereal/" .. name
    local cached = false
    if isfile then pcall(function() cached = isfile(path) end) end
    if not cached then writefile(path, decodeB64(b64)) end
    return getcustomasset(path)
end

function Library:CreateWindow(cfg)
    if type(cfg) ~= "table" then cfg = { Title = tostring(cfg or "ethereal") } end
    local Outer = new("Frame", { Name = "Window", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = typeof(cfg.Size) == "UDim2" and cfg.Size or UDim2.fromOffset(860, 520), BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, Active = true }, ScreenGui)
    bg(Outer, function() return Library.BackgroundColor end)
    corner(Outer, 16)
    local oStroke = new("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1.5, Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, Outer)
    local oGrad = new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 60 }, oStroke)
    new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)), Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 0) }, Outer)
    reg(function() oGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Library.AccentColor, Library.OutlineColor) end)
    Library.Outer = Outer
    Library.Scale = new("UIScale", { Scale = 1 }, Outer)
    Library.BaseScale = 1
    Library.ScaleOverride = nil
    Library.BaseSize = Vector2.new(Outer.Size.X.Offset, Outer.Size.Y.Offset)
    function Library:FitScreen()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
        local bs = Library.BaseSize
        local sc = Library.ScaleOverride or ((vp.X < 1000 or vp.Y < 620) and 0.75 or 1)
        local w = math.clamp((vp.X - 12) / sc, 420, bs.X)
        local h = math.clamp((vp.Y - 12) / sc, 300, bs.Y)
        Outer.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
        Library.BaseScale = sc
        if Library.Toggled then Library.Scale.Scale = sc end
    end
    task.defer(function()
        Library:FitScreen()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam then connect(cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"), function() Library:FitScreen() end) end
    end)
    local Window = { Tabs = {}, Holder = Outer, Current = nil }
    if InputService.TouchEnabled then
        local mb = new("ImageButton", { Name = "EtherealMenuBtn", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.3, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 46), BorderSizePixel = 0, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 50, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit }, ScreenGui)
        corner(mb, 23) stroke(mb) bg(mb, function() return Library.BackgroundColor end)
        local mt = text(mb, { Text = "UL", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = 51 }, "head")
        reg(function() mt.TextColor3 = Library.AccentColor end)
        Library.MobileBtn = mb
        local dragStart, startPos, moved = nil, nil, false
        connect(mb.InputBegan, function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragStart, startPos, moved = i.Position, mb.Position, false end
        end)
        connect(InputService.InputChanged, function(i)
            if dragStart and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
                local d = i.Position - dragStart
                if d.Magnitude > 8 then moved = true end
                if moved then mb.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y) end
            end
        end)
        connect(InputService.InputEnded, function(i)
            if dragStart and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
                if not moved then Library:Toggle() end
                dragStart = nil
            end
        end)
    end

    -- drag strip
    local handle = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -64, 0, 58), Active = true }, Outer)
    local dragging, startPos, startIn = false, nil, nil
    connect(handle.InputBegan, function(i)
        if (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) and not Library.LockUI then
            dragging, startPos, startIn = true, Outer.Position, i.Position
        end
    end)
    connect(InputService.InputChanged, function(i)
        if dragging and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local d = i.Position - startIn
            Outer.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end
    end)
    connect(InputService.InputEnded, function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
    end)

    -- logo (hexagon outline built from bars)
    local logo = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(31, 36), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2) }, Outer)
    local logoBars = {}
    for k = 0, 5 do
        local th = math.rad(k * 60)
        local f = bar(logo, 10 * math.cos(th), 10 * math.sin(th), 11, 3.2, k * 60 + 90)
        corner(f, 2)
        logoBars[#logoBars + 1] = f
    end
    reg(function() for _, f in ipairs(logoBars) do f.BackgroundColor3 = Library.FontColor end end)

    -- sidebar
    local sideList = new("ScrollingFrame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 74), Size = UDim2.new(0, 62, 1, -134), BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 0, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y }, Outer)
    new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, sideList)
    local tip = new("Frame", { Visible = false, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY, Size = UDim2.new(), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 40 }, Outer)
    corner(tip, 8) stroke(tip) bg(tip, function() return Library.MainColor end)
    new("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 5) }, tip)
    local tipText = text(tip, { Text = "", AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY, Size = UDim2.new(), ZIndex = 41 })

    -- avatar
    local av = new("ImageLabel", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 31, 1, -16), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30), BorderSizePixel = 0 }, Outer)
    bg(av, function() return Library.MainColor end)
    corner(av, 15)
    pcall(function() av.Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. LocalPlayer.UserId .. "&w=150&h=150" end)

    -- header: breadcrumb + subtitle + section dropdown
    local crumb = text(Outer, { Text = "", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 14), Size = UDim2.new(1, -460, 0, 18) }, "head")
    local sub = text(Outer, { Text = cfg.Subtitle or "Customize the product as you wish", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 31), Size = UDim2.new(1, -460, 0, 14) }, "small")
    reg(function() sub.TextSize = 10 sub.TextColor3 = Library:Dim():Lerp(Library.BackgroundColor, 0.2) end)
    local ddBtn = new("TextButton", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -18, 0, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 28), BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 20 }, Outer)
    corner(ddBtn, 8) bg(ddBtn, function() return Library.MainColor end)
    local ddCur = text(ddBtn, { Text = "", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 1, 0), ZIndex = 21 })
    local chev = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 21 }, ddBtn)
    local c1 = bar(chev, 3.5, 6, 6, 1.6, 45)
    local c2 = bar(chev, 8.5, 6, 6, 1.6, -45)
    reg(function() c1.BackgroundColor3 = Library:Dim() c2.BackgroundColor3 = Library:Dim() end)
    local ddList = new("Frame", { Visible = false, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -18, 0, 46), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 30 }, Outer)
    corner(ddList, 8) stroke(ddList) bg(ddList, function() return Library.MainColor end)
    new("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, ddList)
    new("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4) }, ddList)

    -- content
    local holder = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 64), Size = UDim2.new(1, -96, 1, -96), ClipsDescendants = true }, Outer)
    local sbox = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -176, 0, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 28), BorderSizePixel = 0 }, Outer)
    corner(sbox, 8) bg(sbox, function() return Library.MainColor end)
    local sIcon = makeIcon(sbox, "search")
    sIcon.Frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 14)
    reg(function() sIcon:SetColor(Library:Dim()) end)
    local search = new("TextBox", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -38, 1, 0), Text = "", PlaceholderText = "Search", ClearTextOnFocus = false, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, sbox)
    reg(function() search.Font = Library.Font search.TextSize = Library.FontSize - 1 search.TextColor3 = Library.FontColor search.PlaceholderColor3 = Library:Dim() end)
    -- footer
    local footer = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 80, 1, -8), Size = UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 18) }, Outer)
    local fdiv = new("Frame", { BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, -4), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1) }, footer)
    bg(fdiv, function() return Library.OutlineColor end)
    local fl = text(footer, { Text = tostring(cfg.Title or "ethereal") .. "  \194\183  " .. LocalPlayer.Name, Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 1, 0) }, "small")
    local fr = text(footer, { Text = "RightShift  \194\183  toggle menu", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 1, 0), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right }, "small")
    Library.KeyHint = fr
    reg(function() fl.TextSize = 11 fr.TextSize = 11 fl.TextColor3 = Library:Dim() fr.TextColor3 = Library:Dim() end)
    local function applySearch()
        local q = search.Text:lower()
        local tab = Window.Current
        if not tab then return end
        for _, sec in ipairs(tab.Sections) do
            local any = false
            local head = q ~= "" and sec.Name:lower():find(q, 1, true) ~= nil
            for _, row in ipairs(sec.Rows) do
                local vis = q == "" or head or row.text:find(q, 1, true) ~= nil
                row.frame.Visible = vis
                if vis then any = true end
            end
            sec.Frame.Visible = q == "" or any or head
        end
    end
    connect(search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), applySearch)

    local function activeSection(tab)
        return tab.Sections[tab.Active or 1]
    end
    local function paintHeader()
        local tab = Window.Current
        if not tab then return end
        local sec = activeSection(tab)
        crumb.Text = tostring(tab.Name) .. (sec and (" / " .. sec.Name) or "")
        ddCur.Text = sec and sec.Name or ""
    end
    local function rebuildDD(tab)
        for _, c in ipairs(ddList:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("TextButton") then c:Destroy() end end
        for i, sec in ipairs(tab.Sections) do
            local b = new("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = "  " .. sec.Name, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, AutoButtonColor = false, LayoutOrder = i, ZIndex = 31, BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, ddList)
            corner(b, 6)
            b.Font = Library.Font b.TextSize = Library.FontSize b.TextColor3 = (tab.Active or 1) == i and Library.AccentColor or Library.FontColor
            connect(b.MouseButton1Click, function()
                local page = tab.Page
                local y = sec.Frame.AbsolutePosition.Y - page.AbsolutePosition.Y + page.CanvasPosition.Y
                page.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(0, y - 2))
                tab.Active = i
                ddList.Visible = false
                paintHeader()
                Library:UpdateColorsUsingRegistry()
            end)
        end
    end
    connect(ddBtn.MouseButton1Click, function() ddList.Visible = not ddList.Visible end)

    local function select(tab)
        Window.Current = tab
        for _, t in ipairs(Window.Tabs) do t.Page.Visible = (t == tab) end
        ddList.Visible = false
        rebuildDD(tab)
        paintHeader()
        Library:UpdateColorsUsingRegistry()
        applySearch()
    end

    function Window:AddTab(name)
        local tab = { Name = name, Sections = {}, Active = 1 }
        local b = new("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40), BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, LayoutOrder = #Window.Tabs + 1 }, sideList)
        corner(b, 10)
        local ic = makeIcon(b, KIND_BY_NAME[tostring(name):lower()] or "circle")
        local ind = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, -11, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 20), BorderSizePixel = 0 }, b)
        corner(ind, 2)
        reg(function()
            local on = Window.Current == tab
            b.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 1
            b.BackgroundColor3 = Library.MainColor
            ind.Visible = on
            ind.BackgroundColor3 = Library.AccentColor
            ic:SetColor(on and Library.AccentColor or Library:Dim(), on and Library.MainColor or Library.BackgroundColor)
        end)
        connect(b.MouseEnter, function() if Window.Current ~= tab then tween(b, 0.12, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.6 }) end end)
        connect(b.MouseLeave, function() if Window.Current ~= tab then tween(b, 0.12, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }) end end)
        connect(b.MouseEnter, function()
            tipText.Text = tostring(name)
            tip.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(66, 74 + b.AbsolutePosition.Y - sideList.AbsolutePosition.Y + 8)
            tip.Visible = true
        end)
        connect(b.MouseLeave, function() tip.Visible = false end)
        connect(b.MouseButton1Click, function() select(tab) end)
        tab.Page = new("ScrollingFrame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 3, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Visible = false }, holder)
        reg(function() tab.Page.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Library.AccentColor end)
        new("UIPadding", { PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8) }, tab.Page)
        local cols = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0) }, tab.Page)
        new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 28), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top }, cols)
        local colL = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -14, 0, 0), LayoutOrder = 1 }, cols)
        local colR = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -14, 0, 0), LayoutOrder = 2 }, cols)
        new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 18), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, colL)
        new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 18), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, colR)
        connect(tab.Page:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"), function()
            local idx, bestY = 1, -1e9
            for i, sec in ipairs(tab.Sections) do
                local y = sec.Frame.AbsolutePosition.Y - tab.Page.AbsolutePosition.Y
                if y <= 14 and y > bestY then idx, bestY = i, y end
            end
            if idx ~= tab.Active then tab.Active = idx if Window.Current == tab then paintHeader() end end
        end)
        local function addSection(sname, col)
            local sec = setmetatable({ Name = sname, Rows = {} }, GB)
            sec.Frame = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = nextOrder() }, col == "R" and colR or colL)
            new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 4), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, sec.Frame)
            local hw = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), LayoutOrder = 0 }, sec.Frame)
            local dot = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -1), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 14), BorderSizePixel = 0 }, hw)
            corner(dot, 2) bg(dot, function() return Library.AccentColor end)
            local head = text(hw, { Text = sname, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -2) }, "head")
            reg(function() head.TextColor3 = Library.FontColor head.TextSize = Library.FontSize + 1 end)
            local chev2 = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0.5, -1), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, hw)
            local k1 = bar(chev2, 3.5, 6, 6, 1.6, 45)
            local k2 = bar(chev2, 8.5, 6, 6, 1.6, -45)
            reg(function() k1.BackgroundColor3 = Library:Dim() k2.BackgroundColor3 = Library:Dim() end)
            local hbtn = new("TextButton", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 5 }, hw)
            local rule = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0 }, hw)
            bg(rule, function() return Library.AccentColor end)
            new("UIGradient", { Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.35), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }) }, rule)
            sec.Body = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), LayoutOrder = 2 }, sec.Frame)
            new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 2), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, sec.Body)
            local collapsed = false
            connect(hbtn.MouseButton1Click, function()
                collapsed = not collapsed
                sec.Body.Visible = not collapsed
                chev2.Rotation = collapsed and -90 or 0
            end)
            tab.Sections[#tab.Sections + 1] = sec
            if Window.Current == tab then rebuildDD(tab) paintHeader() end
            return sec
        end
        function tab:AddLeftGroupbox(n) return addSection(n, "L") end
        function tab:AddRightGroupbox(n) return addSection(n, "R") end
        function tab:AddGroupbox(n) return addSection(n, (#colL:GetChildren() <= #colR:GetChildren()) and "L" or "R") end
        function tab:AddBlank() end
        Window.Tabs[#Window.Tabs + 1] = tab
        if #Window.Tabs == 1 then select(tab) end
        return tab
    end

connect(InputService.InputBegan, function(i)
    if InputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
        local lt = Library.Listening
        if lt then
            Library.Listening = nil
            if i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape or i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace then lt:SetKey(nil) else lt:SetKey(i.KeyCode.Name) end
            return
        end
        for _, tg in pairs(Toggles) do
            if tg.Key and tg.Key == i.KeyCode.Name then tg:SetValue(not tg.Value) end
        end
    end
    local kb = Library.ToggleKeybind
    local v = type(kb) == "table" and kb.Value or kb
    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and v and i.KeyCode.Name == v then Library:Toggle() end
end)

function Library:OnUnload(cb) Library.UnloadCallbacks[#Library.UnloadCallbacks + 1] = cb end
function Library:Unload()
    if Library.Unloaded then return end
    Library.Unloaded = true
    for _, cb in ipairs(Library.UnloadCallbacks) do pcall(cb) end
    for _, c in ipairs(Library.Signals) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    pcall(function() ModalBtn.Modal = false end)
    pcall(function() if Library.Blur then Library.Blur:Destroy() end end)
    pcall(function() ScreenGui:Destroy() end)
    pcall(function()
        local g = genv()
        if g.Vercel_Library == Library then g.Vercel_Library = nil end
        if g.Toggles == Toggles then g.Toggles = nil end
        if g.Options == Options then g.Options = nil end
    end)
end

pcall(function()
    local g = genv()
    g.Vercel_Library, g.Vercel_Toggles, g.Vercel_Options = Library, Toggles, Options
    if g.Toggles == nil then g.Toggles = Toggles end
    if g.Options == nil then g.Options = Options end
end)
return Library
]==========]

local ROOT_FOLDER        = "vercelcc"
local PROFILES_FOLDER    = ROOT_FOLDER .. "/profiles"
local GLOBAL_CFG_FILE    = ROOT_FOLDER .. "/global_config.json"
local ACTIVE_PROFILE_FILE = ROOT_FOLDER .. "/active_profile.txt"

local function ensureFolders()
    local function mf(path) if not isfolder(path) then pcall(makefolder, path) end end
    mf(ROOT_FOLDER); mf(PROFILES_FOLDER)
end

local function safeWrite(path, content) return pcall(writefile, path, content) end
local function safeRead(path) local ok, d = pcall(readfile, path); return ok and d or nil end
local function safeDelete(path) pcall(delfile, path) end

local function jsonEncode(t)
    local ok, s = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(t) end)
    return ok and s or nil
end
local function jsonDecode(s)
    local ok, t = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(s) end)
    return ok and t or nil
end

local function getActiveProfileName() return safeRead(ACTIVE_PROFILE_FILE) end
local function setActiveProfileName(name)
    if name then safeWrite(ACTIVE_PROFILE_FILE, name) else safeDelete(ACTIVE_PROFILE_FILE) end
end

local function profilePath(name)
    local safe = name:gsub("[^%w%-%_ ]", ""):sub(1, 48)
    return PROFILES_FOLDER .. "/" .. safe .. ".json"
end

local function listProfiles()
    local names = {}
    local ok, files = pcall(listfiles, PROFILES_FOLDER)
    if not ok or not files then return names end
    for _, path in ipairs(files) do
        local name = path:match("([^/\\]+)%.json$")
        if name then table.insert(names, name) end
    end
    table.sort(names); return names
end

local function saveProfile(name)
    name = name:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
    if name == "" then return false, "Enter a profile name" end
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(getgenv().config) do t[k] = v end
    local s = jsonEncode(t)
    if not s then return false, "JSON encode failed" end
    local ok, err = safeWrite(profilePath(name), s)
    if not ok then return false, tostring(err) end
    setActiveProfileName(name)
    return true, "Saved profile: " .. name
end

local function loadProfile(name)
    local raw = safeRead(profilePath(name))
    if not raw then return false, "Profile not found" end
    local data = jsonDecode(raw)
    if not data then return false, "Corrupted profile" end
    for k, v in pairs(data) do
        if getgenv().config[k] ~= nil then
            if type(getgenv().config[k]) == type(v) then getgenv().config[k] = v end
        end
    end
    setActiveProfileName(name)
    return true, "Loaded: " .. name
end

local function deleteProfile(name)
    safeDelete(profilePath(name))
    if getActiveProfileName() == name then setActiveProfileName(nil) end
    return true, "Deleted: " .. name
end

local function saveGlobalConfig()
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(getgenv().config) do t[k] = v end
    local s = jsonEncode(t)
    if s then safeWrite(GLOBAL_CFG_FILE, s) end
end

local function loadGlobalConfig()
    local raw = safeRead(GLOBAL_CFG_FILE)
    if not raw then return end
    local data = jsonDecode(raw)
    if not data then return end
    for k, v in pairs(data) do
        if getgenv().config[k] ~= nil and type(getgenv().config[k]) == type(v) then
            getgenv().config[k] = v
        end
    end
end

pcall(loadGlobalConfig)

local function getHrp()
    return localplayer.Character and localplayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function getClosest()
    local closest, minD = nil, math.huge
    local hrp = getHrp()
    if not hrp then return nil end
    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= localplayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            if localplayer.Team == nil or p.Team == nil or localplayer.Team ~= p.Team then
                local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                    local d = (hrp.Position - p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < minD then minD = d; closest = p end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return closest
end

local function safeTeleport(pos)
    local hrp = getHrp()
    if not hrp then return end
    local x, y, z = pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z
    y = math.clamp(y, 2, hrp.Position.Y + 800)
    local p = RaycastParams.new()
    p.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    p.FilterDescendantsInstances = { localplayer.Character }
    local hit = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x, y + 60, z), Vector3.new(0, -220, 0), p)
    if hit then y = math.max(hit.Position.Y + 3, 2) end
    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(x, y, z)
end

end))

local voidConn1, voidConn2, voidConn3, voidToggle = nil, nil, nil, false
getgenv().startVoid = function()
    if voidConn1 then voidConn1:Disconnect() end
    if voidConn2 then voidConn2:Disconnect() end
    if voidConn3 then voidConn3:Disconnect() end
    voidConn1 = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not config.VoidEnabled or not getHrp() then return end
        voidToggle = not voidToggle
        local hrp = getHrp()
        local vx, vy, vz = config.voidX, config.voidY, config.voidZ
        if voidToggle then hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(math.random(-vx, vx), vy, math.random(-vz, vz))
        else hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(math.random(vx, vx * 2), -vy, math.random(vz, vz * 2)) end
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-1e5, 1e5), math.random(-1e5, 1e5), math.random(-1e5, 1e5))
        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-1e5, 1e5), math.random(-1e5, 1e5), math.random(-1e5, 1e5))
    end)
    voidConn2 = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not config.VoidEnabled or not getHrp() then return end
        getHrp().CFrame = getHrp().CFrame * CFrame.new(math.random(-50, 50), math.random(-50, 50), math.random(-50, 50))
    end)
    voidConn3 = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
        if not config.VoidEnabled or not getHrp() then return end
        if getHrp().Position.Magnitude > 1e7 then getHrp().CFrame = CFrame.new(0, config.voidY, 0) end
    end)
end
getgenv().stopVoid = function()
    if voidConn1 then voidConn1:Disconnect() voidConn1 = nil end
    if voidConn2 then voidConn2:Disconnect() voidConn2 = nil end
    if voidConn3 then voidConn3:Disconnect() voidConn3 = nil end
end
local voidSpamConn, voidSpamCharConn, voidSpamExtra, voidAnchorPos = nil, nil, nil, nil
local voidFoe, voidFoeAt = nil, 0
local voidRotNext = 0
local voidRays, voidRaysAt, voidThreatened, voidPanicUntil, voidHpConn = {}, 0, false, 0, nil
local function refreshVoidRays(rootPos)
    if tick() - voidRaysAt < 0.1 then return end
    voidRaysAt = tick()
    table.clear(voidRays)
    voidThreatened = false
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= localplayer then
            local ch = p.Character
            local h = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if h and hum and hum.Health > 0 and h.Position.Magnitude < 1e5 and (h.Position - rootPos).Magnitude < 500 then
                local o, d = h.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), h.CFrame.LookVector
                voidRays[#voidRays + 1] = { o, d }
                local to = rootPos - o
                if to.Magnitude < 400 and to.Magnitude > 0.1 and d:Dot(to.Unit) > 0.96 then voidThreatened = true end
            end
        end
    end
end
local function voidRayDanger(pos)
    for i = 1, #voidRays do
        local r = voidRays[i]
        local to = pos - r[1]
        local t = to:Dot(r[2])
        if t > 0 and (to - r[2] * t).Magnitude < 7 then return true end
    end
    return false
end
local voidScatterOrig = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local voidSpiralAngle = 0
local voidWaveTime    = 0
local voidBounceDir   = { X = 1, Y = 1, Z = 1 }
local voidChaosSeeds  = { math.random(), math.random(), math.random() }
local voidHelixT      = 0
local voidStrobePhase = false

local getVoidSpamDelta
getVoidSpamDelta = function(dt)
    local xp, xn = config.voidXPos, config.voidXNeg
    local yp, yn = config.voidYPos, config.voidYNeg
    local zp, zn = config.voidZPos, config.voidZNeg
    local ax, ay, az = config.voidAxisX, config.voidAxisY, config.voidAxisZ
    local p = config.voidPattern
    if p == "spiral" then
        voidSpiralAngle = voidSpiralAngle + 0.35
        return Vector3.new(ax and math.cos(voidSpiralAngle) * (xp + xn) / 2 or 0, ay and math.sin(voidSpiralAngle * 0.6) * (yp + yn) / 2 or 0, az and math.sin(voidSpiralAngle) * (zp + zn) / 2 or 0)
    elseif p == "wave" then
        voidWaveTime = voidWaveTime + dt * 8
        return Vector3.new(ax and math.sin(voidWaveTime) * (xp + xn) / 2 or 0, ay and math.sin(voidWaveTime * 1.7) * (yp + yn) / 2 or 0, az and math.cos(voidWaveTime * 0.9) * (zp + zn) / 2 or 0)
    elseif p == "bounce" then
        local step = Vector3.new(ax and voidBounceDir.X * (xp + xn) / 3 or 0, ay and voidBounceDir.Y * (yp + yn) / 3 or 0, az and voidBounceDir.Z * (zp + zn) / 3 or 0)
        if math.random() < 0.25 then voidBounceDir.X = -voidBounceDir.X end
        if math.random() < 0.25 then voidBounceDir.Y = -voidBounceDir.Y end
        if math.random() < 0.25 then voidBounceDir.Z = -voidBounceDir.Z end
        return step
    elseif p == "chaos" then
        voidChaosSeeds[1] = (voidChaosSeeds[1] * 1664525 + 1013904223) % 1
        voidChaosSeeds[2] = (voidChaosSeeds[2] * 22695477 + 1) % 1
        voidChaosSeeds[3] = (voidChaosSeeds[3] * 214013 + 2531011) % 1
        return Vector3.new(ax and (voidChaosSeeds[1] * (xp + xn) - xn) or 0, ay and (voidChaosSeeds[2] * (yp + yn) - yn) or 0, az and (voidChaosSeeds[3] * (zp + zn) - zn) or 0)
    elseif p == "cross" then
        local tog = (math.floor(tick() * 10)) % 2 == 0
        return Vector3.new(ax and (tog and (math.random() * (xp + xn) - xn) or 0) or 0, ay and (not tog and (math.random() * (yp + yn) - yn) or 0) or 0, az and (tog and (math.random() * (zp + zn) - zn) or 0) or 0)
    elseif p == "helix" then
        voidHelixT = voidHelixT + dt * 6
        return Vector3.new(ax and math.cos(voidHelixT * 2) * (xp + xn) / 2 or 0, ay and math.sin(voidHelixT) * (yp + yn) / 8 or 0, az and math.sin(voidHelixT * 2) * (zp + zn) / 2 or 0)
    elseif p == "strobe" then
        voidStrobePhase = not voidStrobePhase
        local s = voidStrobePhase and 1 or -1
        return Vector3.new(ax and s * xp or 0, ay and s * yp or 0, az and s * zp or 0)
    elseif p == "sphere" then
        local r = math.max(xp + xn, yp + yn, zp + zn) / 2
        local v = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5)
        if v.Magnitude < 0.01 then v = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
        v = v.Unit * r
        return Vector3.new(ax and v.X or 0, ay and v.Y or 0, az and v.Z or 0)
    elseif p == "ring" then
        voidSpiralAngle = voidSpiralAngle + 2.399
        local r = (xp + xn) / 2
        return Vector3.new(ax and math.cos(voidSpiralAngle) * r or 0, ay and (math.random() - 0.5) * (yp + yn) or 0, az and math.sin(voidSpiralAngle) * r or 0)
    elseif p == "grid" then
        voidHelixT = voidHelixT + 1
        local i = math.floor(voidHelixT)
        local gx, gz, gy = (i * 7) % 9 - 4, (i * 5 + math.floor(i / 9)) % 9 - 4, (i * 3) % 5 - 2
        return Vector3.new(ax and gx * (xp + xn) / 8 or 0, ay and gy * (yp + yn) / 4 or 0, az and gz * (zp + zn) / 8 or 0)
    elseif p == "figure8" then
        voidWaveTime = voidWaveTime + dt * 14
        return Vector3.new(ax and math.sin(voidWaveTime) * (xp + xn) / 2 or 0, ay and math.sin(voidWaveTime * 3) * (yp + yn) / 4 or 0, az and math.sin(voidWaveTime * 2) * (zp + zn) / 2 or 0)
    elseif p == "underground" then
        return Vector3.new(ax and (math.random() * (xp + xn) - xn) or 0, -math.random() * (yp + yn), az and (math.random() * (zp + zn) - zn) or 0)
    elseif p == "stack" then
        return Vector3.new(ax and (math.random() - 0.5) * 6 or 0, ay and (math.random() - 0.5) * (yp + yn) or 0, az and (math.random() - 0.5) * 6 or 0)
    elseif p == "mixed" then
        local pick = math.random(1, 7)
        config.voidPattern = ({ "random", "sphere", "ring", "chaos", "underground", "stack", "helix" })[pick]
        local d = getVoidSpamDelta(dt)
        config.voidPattern = "mixed"
        return d
    else
        return Vector3.new(ax and (math.random() * (xp + xn) - xn) or 0, ay and (math.random() * (yp + yn) - yn) or 0, az and (math.random() * (zp + zn) - zn) or 0)
    end
end

local function voidScatterNow(rad)
    pcall(function()
        local ch = localplayer.Character
        if not ch then return end
        for _, m in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
            if m:IsA("Motor6D") and m.Name ~= "RootJoint" and m.Part0 and m.Part1 then
                if voidScatterOrig[m] == nil then voidScatterOrig[m] = m.C0 end
                m.C0 = voidScatterOrig[m] * CFrame.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * rad, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * rad, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * rad) * CFrame.Angles(math.random() * 6.28, math.random() * 6.28, math.random() * 6.28)
            end
        end
    end)
end

getgenv().startVoidSpam = function()
    if voidSpamConn then return end
    voidSpiralAngle = 0; voidWaveTime = 0; voidHelixT = 0; voidStrobePhase = false
    voidBounceDir = { X = 1, Y = 1, Z = 1 }; voidChaosSeeds = { math.random(), math.random(), math.random() }
    local root, humanoid
    local function refreshChar()
        local ch = localplayer.Character
        if not ch then root = nil; humanoid = nil; return end
        root = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); humanoid = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end
    refreshChar()
    local lastHp = humanoid and humanoid.Health or 100
    local function hookHp()
        if voidHpConn then voidHpConn:Disconnect() voidHpConn = nil end
        if humanoid then
            lastHp = humanoid.Health
            voidHpConn = humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(h)
                if h < lastHp and config.voidPanic then voidPanicUntil = tick() + 1.5 end
                lastHp = h
            end)
        end
    end
    hookHp()
    voidAnchorPos = root and root.Position or nil
    voidSpamCharConn = localplayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch)
        root = ch:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart"); humanoid = ch:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
        hookHp()
        task.wait(0.2)
        if config.voidSpamEnabled and humanoid then humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics) end
    end)
    local acc, dtBuf = 0, 0
    local function step(dt)
        if not config.voidSpamEnabled then getgenv().stopVoidSpam(); return end
        if not root or not root.Parent then refreshChar(); return end
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
        dtBuf = dtBuf + dt; acc = acc + dt
        local interval = math.max(config.voidSpamInterval, 0.001)
        if (config.voidJitter or 0) > 0 then interval = interval * (1 + (math.random() - 0.5) * config.voidJitter) end
        if acc < interval then return end
        acc = acc % interval
        local burst = math.clamp(config.voidSpamBurst, 1, 400)
        if config.voidSpamMax then burst = math.min(400, burst * 2) end
        if config.voidSmart or config.voidDodge then refreshVoidRays(root.Position) end
        if config.voidSmart then
            if voidThreatened or tick() < voidPanicUntil then burst = math.min(400, burst) else burst = math.max(8, math.floor(burst * 0.35)) end
        end
        if config.voidPanic and tick() < voidPanicUntil then burst = math.min(400, math.floor(burst * 1.6) + 10) end
        local t0, budget = os.clock(), (config.voidBudget or 8) / 1000
        if config.voidRotate and tick() >= (voidRotNext or 0) then
            voidRotNext = tick() + (config.voidRotateEvery or 1.5)
            local list = { "random", "sphere", "ring", "chaos", "underground", "stack", "helix", "spiral", "figure8", "strobe" }
            config.voidPattern = list[math.random(1, #list)]
        end
        local foe
        local basePat = config.voidPattern
        if config.voidAdaptive or basePat == "decoy" or basePat == "mirror" or basePat == "mixed" then
            if tick() - (voidFoeAt or 0) > 0.1 then voidFoeAt = tick() voidFoe = getClosest() end
            foe = voidFoe
        end
        if config.voidAdaptive then
            local fr = foe and foe.Character and foe.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local d = fr and (fr.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
            if not d or d > (config.voidAdaptRange or 150) then burst = math.max(1, math.floor(burst / 4)) end
        end
        local realCF = root.CFrame
        local look = realCF.LookVector
        local scEvery = math.max(1, math.floor(burst / math.max(config.voidScatterRate or 4, 1)))
        local foeRoot = foe and foe.Character and foe.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        for bi = 1, burst do
            if not root or not root.Parent then break end
            if bi % 8 == 0 and os.clock() - t0 > budget then break end
            local newPos
            local pat = basePat
            if pat == "mixed" and foeRoot and math.random() < 0.35 then pat = math.random() < 0.5 and "decoy" or "mirror" end
            if pat == "decoy" and foeRoot then
                -- hop around the enemy at random distances so aim prediction has nothing stable to lock on
                local ep = foeRoot.Position
                local ang, rad = math.random() * math.pi * 2, math.random(12, 70)
                newPos = ep + Vector3.new(math.cos(ang) * rad, math.random(-4, 22), math.sin(ang) * rad)
            elseif pat == "mirror" and foeRoot then
                -- appear on the far side of the enemy
                local ep = foeRoot.Position
                newPos = ep + (ep - realCF.Position) + Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 30, math.random(-3, 20), (math.random() - 0.5) * 30)
            else
                local pos = (config.voidAnchor and voidAnchorPos) or root.Position
                for _ = 1, (config.voidDodge and 3 or 1) do
                    local delta = getVoidSpamDelta(dtBuf / burst)
                    if config.voidSmooth then
                        newPos = pos:Lerp(pos + delta, math.clamp(config.voidSmoothAlpha, 0.01, 1))
                    else newPos = pos + delta end
                    if not (config.voidDodge and voidRayDanger(newPos)) then break end
                end
            end
            root.CFrame = CFrame.new(newPos, newPos + look)
            if (config.voidVel or 0) > 0 then
                pcall(function() root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5).Unit * config.voidVel end)
            end
            if config.voidScatter and bi % scEvery == 0 then voidScatterNow(config.voidScatterRadius or 25) end
        end
        if config.voidSpamMax then
            pcall(function()
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-3000, 3000), math.random(-3000, 3000), math.random(-3000, 3000))
                root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-200, 200), math.random(-200, 200), math.random(-200, 200))
            end)
        end
        if config.voidReturn and root and root.Parent then root.CFrame = realCF; root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero pcall(function() root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end) end
        dtBuf = 0
    end
    voidSpamConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(step)
    -- Max mode also runs every physics step and every render frame, so it fires 3x per frame
    voidSpamExtra = {
        RunService.Stepped:Connect(function(_, dt) if config.voidSpamMax then step(dt) end end),
        RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt) if config.voidSpamMax then step(dt) end end),
        RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt) if config.voidSpamMax then step(dt) end end),
        RunService.PostSimulation:Connect(function(dt) if config.voidSpamMax then step(dt) end end),
    }
end
getgenv().stopVoidSpam = function()
    for m, c0 in pairs(voidScatterOrig) do pcall(function() m.C0 = c0 end) end
    table.clear(voidScatterOrig)
    if voidSpamExtra then for _, c in ipairs(voidSpamExtra) do c:Disconnect() end voidSpamExtra = nil end
    if voidSpamConn then voidSpamConn:Disconnect() voidSpamConn = nil end
    if voidSpamCharConn then voidSpamCharConn:Disconnect() voidSpamCharConn = nil end
    if voidHpConn then voidHpConn:Disconnect() voidHpConn = nil end
    config.voidSpamEnabled = false
end

local orbConn, orbAngle = nil, 0
getgenv().startOrbit = function()
    if orbConn then orbConn:Disconnect() end
    local hum = localplayer.Character and localplayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics) end
    orbAngle = 0
    orbConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not config.orbit then return end
        local myHrp = getHrp()
        if not myHrp then return end
        local cl = getClosest()
        if cl and cl.Character then
            local hrp = cl.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                local speedMod = (config.orbitSpeed or 90) / 500
                orbAngle = orbAngle + speedMod
                local radius = config.orbitDistance or 8
                local height = config.orbitHeight or 0
                local offset = Vector3.new(math.cos(orbAngle) * radius, height, math.sin(orbAngle) * radius)
                myHrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position + offset, hrp.Position)
                pcall(function()
                    myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    myHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end)
            end
        end
    end)
end
getgenv().stopOrbit = function()
    if orbConn then orbConn:Disconnect() orbConn = nil end
    config.orbit = false
end
local tpConn

end
