local evasionConn, blinkConn, ghostConn = nil, nil, nil
getgenv().startEvasion = function()
    if evasionConn then evasionConn:Disconnect() end
    local t0, s1, s2, s3 = tick(), math.random(1e3, 9e3), math.random(1e3, 9e3), math.random(1e3, 9e3)
    evasionConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not config.evasionEnabled or not getHrp() then return end
        local t, i = tick() - t0, config.evasionIntensity
        local r1, r2, r3 = 500 * 0.18 * i, 500 * 0.35 * i, 500 * 0.55 * i
        local oX = math.cos(t * 18.7) * r1 + math.cos(t * 7.3 + s1) * r2 + math.cos(t * 2.1 + s2) * r3
        local oZ = math.sin(t * 18.7) * r1 + math.sin(t * 7.3 + s1) * r2 + math.sin(t * 2.1 + s2) * r3
        local oY = math.sin(t * 11.3 + s3) * 500 * 0.12 * i + math.sin(t * 5.7) * 500 * 0.08 * i
        local jX = math.noise(t * 8, s1, 0) * 40 * i
        local jY = math.noise(0, t * 8, s2) * 20 * i
        local jZ = math.noise(0, 0, t * 8 + s3) * 40 * i
        safeTeleport(getHrp().Position + Vector3.new(oX + jX, oY + jY, oZ + jZ))
    end)
end
getgenv().stopEvasion = function() if evasionConn then evasionConn:Disconnect() evasionConn = nil end end

local blinkAnchor = nil
getgenv().startBlink = function()
    if blinkConn then blinkConn:Disconnect() end
    if getHrp() then blinkAnchor = getHrp().Position end
    local lastSnap, anchorT, seed = 0, 0, math.random(1e3, 9e3)
    blinkConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not config.blinkEnabled or not getHrp() then return end
        anchorT = anchorT + dt
        blinkAnchor = (blinkAnchor or getHrp().Position) + Vector3.new(math.sin(anchorT * 1.3 + seed) * 12, math.sin(anchorT * 2.1) * 3, math.cos(anchorT * 1.7 + seed) * 12) * dt
        local now = tick()
        if (now - lastSnap) >= (1 / config.blinkRate) then
            lastSnap = now
            local a, d = math.random() * math.pi * 2, math.random() * config.blinkRadius
            safeTeleport(Vector3.new(blinkAnchor.X + math.cos(a) * d, blinkAnchor.Y + (math.random() - 0.5) * config.blinkRadius * 0.3, blinkAnchor.Z + math.sin(a) * d))
        end
    end)
end
getgenv().stopBlink = function() if blinkConn then blinkConn:Disconnect() blinkConn = nil end end

getgenv().startGhost = function()
    if ghostConn then ghostConn:Disconnect() end
    local flip, t0, seed = false, tick(), math.random(1e3, 9e3)
    ghostConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not config.ghostEnabled or not getHrp() then return end
        flip = not flip
        if flip then
            local a = (tick() - t0) * 4.3 + seed
            safeTeleport(Vector3.new(getHrp().Position.X + math.cos(a) * config.ghostDistance, getHrp().Position.Y, getHrp().Position.Z + math.sin(a) * config.ghostDistance))
        end
    end)
end
getgenv().stopGhost = function() if ghostConn then ghostConn:Disconnect() ghostConn = nil end end

local glideConn = nil
getgenv().startGlide = function()
    if glideConn then glideConn:Disconnect() end
    local hum = localplayer.Character and localplayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics) end
    local vel = Vector3.zero
    glideConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not config.glideEnabled then getgenv().stopGlide(); return end
        local hrp = getHrp(); if not hrp then return end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local cf  = cam and cam.CFrame or hrp.CFrame
        local f   = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z).Unit
        local r   = Vector3.new(cf.RightVector.X, 0, cf.RightVector.Z).Unit
        local humC = localplayer.Character and localplayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local md   = humC and humC.MoveDirection or Vector3.zero
        local wish = Vector3.zero
        if md.Magnitude > 0.001 then
            wish = f * md:Dot(f) + r * md:Dot(r)
            if wish.Magnitude > 0.001 then wish = wish.Unit end
        end
        local accel = math.clamp(config.glideAccel, 1, 100)
        vel = vel:Lerp(wish * config.glideSpeed, 1 - math.exp(-accel * dt))
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, vel.Z)
    end)
end
getgenv().stopGlide = function()
    if glideConn then glideConn:Disconnect() glideConn = nil end
    config.glideEnabled = false
end
local riotAbuserConn = nil
getgenv().startRiotAbuser = function()
    if riotAbuserConn then riotAbuserConn:Disconnect() end
    local t0, seed = tick(), math.random(1e3, 9e3)
    local hrp = getHrp()
    if hrp then getgenv().riotAbuserOriginal = hrp.CFrame end
    riotAbuserConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not config.riotAbuserEnabled or not getHrp() then return end
        local t = tick() - t0
        local hrp2 = getHrp()
        local yaw   = math.rad(config.riotAbuserSpin * dt)
        local pitch = math.rad(config.riotAbuserSpin * 0.37 * dt * math.sin(t * 3.1))
        local roll  = math.rad(config.riotAbuserSpin * 0.19 * dt * math.cos(t * 5.7 + seed))
        local spinCF = hrp2.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(pitch, yaw, roll)
        local spread = config.riotAbuserDistance / 300
        local jX = (math.random() - 0.5) * config.riotAbuserX * spread * 2 + math.noise(t * 9, seed, 0) * config.riotAbuserX * spread
        local jY = (math.random() - 0.5) * config.riotAbuserY * spread + math.noise(0, t * 9, seed) * config.riotAbuserY * spread * 0.3
        local jZ = (math.random() - 0.5) * config.riotAbuserZ * spread * 2 + math.noise(0, 0, t * 9 + seed) * config.riotAbuserZ * spread
        local newY = math.max(spinCF.Position.Y + jY, 2)
        hrp2.CFrame = spinCF + Vector3.new(jX, newY - spinCF.Position.Y, jZ)
    end)
end
getgenv().stopRiotAbuser = function()
    if riotAbuserConn then riotAbuserConn:Disconnect() riotAbuserConn = nil end
    if getHrp() and getgenv().riotAbuserOriginal then getHrp().CFrame = getgenv().riotAbuserOriginal end
end

local riotBypassConn, riotBypassTarget = nil, nil
local riotBypassLastSnap = 0
getgenv().startRiotBypass = function()
    if riotBypassConn then riotBypassConn:Disconnect() end
    riotBypassConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not config.riotBypassEnabled or not getHrp() then return end
        if not riotBypassTarget or not riotBypassTarget.Character or not riotBypassTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") or riotBypassTarget.Character.Humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            riotBypassTarget = getClosest()
            return
        end
        local tr = riotBypassTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not tr then return end
        local now = tick()
        if (now - riotBypassLastSnap) < config.riotBypassUpdate then return end
        riotBypassLastSnap = now
        local hrp = getHrp()
        if not hrp then return end
        
        local targetPos = tr.Position
        local targetLook = tr.CFrame.LookVector
        local distance = config.riotBypassDistance or 3
        local heightOffset = config.riotBypassHeight or 0
        local calculatedCFrame = hrp.CFrame
        local mode = config.riotBypassPosition or "Front"
        
        if mode == "Front" then
            calculatedCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(targetPos + (targetLook * distance) + Vector3.new(0, heightOffset, 0), targetPos + Vector3.new(0, heightOffset, 0))
        elseif mode == "Back" then
            calculatedCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(targetPos - (targetLook * distance) + Vector3.new(0, heightOffset, 0), targetPos + Vector3.new(0, heightOffset, 0))
        elseif mode == "Above" then
            calculatedCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(targetPos + Vector3.new(0, distance + heightOffset, 0), targetPos + Vector3.new(0, heightOffset, 0))
        elseif mode == "Below" then
            calculatedCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(targetPos + Vector3.new(0, -distance + heightOffset, 0), targetPos + Vector3.new(0, heightOffset, 0))
        end
        
        hrp.CFrame = calculatedCFrame
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end)
end
getgenv().stopRiotBypass = function()
    if riotBypassConn then riotBypassConn:Disconnect() riotBypassConn = nil end
    riotBypassTarget = nil
    riotBypassLastSnap = 0
end

local slingRageConn, slingProjA, slingProjB
local slingTarget = CFrame.new(9000, 9000, 9000)
local slingProjs  = {}
getgenv().startSlingRage = function()
    if slingRageConn then slingRageConn:Disconnect() end
    slingProjA = workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(o)
        if not o:IsA("BasePart") then return end
        if o.Name == "CoreProjectile" then slingProjs[o] = true
        elseif o.Name == "Part" then task.defer(function()
            if o and o.Parent and o.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 50 then slingProjs[o] = true end
        end) end
    end)
    slingProjB = workspace.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(o) slingProjs[o] = nil end)
    slingRageConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not config.slingRage then return end
        pcall(function()
            for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= localplayer and p.Character then
                    local h = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if h then h.CFrame = slingTarget; h.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero; h.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end
                end
            end
            for _, o in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                if o.Name == "CoreProjectile" and o:IsA("BasePart") then
                    o.CFrame = slingTarget; o.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end
            end
            for p in pairs(slingProjs) do
                if p and p.Parent then p.CFrame = slingTarget; p.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                else slingProjs[p] = nil end
            end
        end)
    end)
end
getgenv().stopSlingRage = function()
    if slingRageConn then slingRageConn:Disconnect() slingRageConn = nil end
    if slingProjA then slingProjA:Disconnect() slingProjA = nil end
    if slingProjB then slingProjB:Disconnect() slingProjB = nil end
    slingProjs = {}
end

local apConn, apProjA, apProjB
local apTarget = CFrame.new(999999, 999999, 999999)
local apProjs  = {}
getgenv().startAntiProj = function()
    if apConn then apConn:Disconnect() end
    apProjA = workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(o)
        if not o:IsA("BasePart") then return end
        if o.Name == "CoreProjectile" then apProjs[o] = true
        elseif o.Name == "Part" then task.defer(function()
            if o and o.Parent and o.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 50 then apProjs[o] = true end
        end) end
    end)
    apProjB = workspace.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(o) apProjs[o] = nil end)
    apConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not config.antiProj then return end
        pcall(function()
            for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= localplayer and p.Character then
                    local h = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if h then h.CFrame = apTarget; h.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero; h.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end
                end
            end
            for _, o in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                if o.Name == "CoreProjectile" and o:IsA("BasePart") then
                    o.CFrame = apTarget; o.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end
            end
            for p in pairs(apProjs) do
                if p and p.Parent then p.CFrame = apTarget; p.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                else apProjs[p] = nil end
            end
        end)
    end)
end
getgenv().stopAntiProj = function()
    if apConn then apConn:Disconnect() apConn = nil end
    if apProjA then apProjA:Disconnect() apProjA = nil end
    if apProjB then apProjB:Disconnect() apProjB = nil end

end

local antiCloseConn = nil
getgenv().startAntiClose = function()
    if antiCloseConn then antiCloseConn:Disconnect() end
    antiCloseConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not config.antiClose then return end
        local hrp = getHrp(); if not hrp then return end
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= localplayer and plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                if (hrp.Position - plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude < 20 then
                    hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 60 + Vector3.new(0, 30, 0)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end
getgenv().stopAntiClose = function() if antiCloseConn then antiCloseConn:Disconnect() antiCloseConn = nil end end

getgenv().startFastReload = function()
    local ok, ItemLibrary = pcall(function() return require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.ItemLibrary) end)
    if not ok or not ItemLibrary then return end
    local Items = rawget(ItemLibrary, "Items"); if not Items then return end
    task.spawn(function()
        while config.fastReload do
            for _, Item in pairs(Items) do
                pcall(function()
                    local speed = Item.Name == "Daggers" and 0.09 or 0
                    rawset(Item, "ReloadLength", speed); rawset(Item, "FireRate", 0)
                    rawset(Item, "Cooldown", 0); rawset(Item, "AttackCooldown", 0)
                    rawset(Item, "SwingCooldown", 0); rawset(Item, "ThrowCooldown", 0)
                    rawset(Item, "RecoverTime", 0); rawset(Item, "WindupTime", 0)
                end)
            end
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
    end)
end
getgenv().stopFastReload = function() config.fastReload = false end
local lastShootTime = 0
local function handleWallbang()
    if not config.wallbangEnabled then return end
    local cl = getClosest(); local hrp = getHrp(); local char = localplayer.Character
    if cl and cl.Character and cl.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") and hrp and char then
        local hd  = cl.Character.Head
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, hd.Position)
        local t = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if t then t:Activate() end
        if tick() - lastShootTime > 0.05 then
            lastShootTime = tick()
            pcall(function()
                if UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled then
                    local center = cam.ViewportSize / 2
                    if firetouchtap then firetouchtap(center) elseif touchtap then touchtap(center) end
                else
                    if mouse1click then mouse1click() else VirtualUser:ClickButton1(Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y / 2)) end
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end
getgenv().startWallbang = function() RunService:BindToRenderStep("WbAimFix", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, handleWallbang) end
getgenv().stopWallbang  = function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("WbAimFix") end

local rapidFireConn = nil
getgenv().startRapidFire = function()
    if rapidFireConn then rapidFireConn:Disconnect() end
    rapidFireConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if config.rapidFire then
            local t = localplayer.Character and localplayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if t then t:Activate() end
        end
    end)
end
getgenv().stopRapidFire = function() if rapidFireConn then rapidFireConn:Disconnect() rapidFireConn = nil end end

local autocollectConn, homeConn, loopConn, safeZoneConn = nil, nil, nil, nil
getgenv().startAutocollect = function()
    if autocollectConn then autocollectConn:Disconnect() end
    autocollectConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not config.autocollectEnabled or not getHrp() then return end
        local best, minD = nil, math.huge
        for _, o in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            local n = o.Name:lower()
            if n:find("heal") or n:find("health") or n:find("medkit") or n:find("bandage") then
                local p = o:IsA("Model") and (o.PrimaryPart or o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")) or (o:IsA("BasePart") and o or nil)
                if p then
                    local d = (p.Position - getHrp().Position).Magnitude
                    if d < minD and d <= config.autocollectRadius then minD = d; best = p.Position end
                end
            end
        end
        if best then safeTeleport(best) end
    end)
end
getgenv().stopAutocollect = function() if autocollectConn then autocollectConn:Disconnect() autocollectConn = nil end end

getgenv().startReturnHome = function()
    if homeConn then homeConn:Disconnect() end
    if not getgenv().homePosition and getHrp() then getgenv().homePosition = getHrp().Position end
    local lastRet = 0
    homeConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not config.returnHomeEnabled or not getHrp() or not getgenv().homePosition then return end
        if (getHrp().Position - getgenv().homePosition).Magnitude > 50 and (tick() - lastRet) >= config.homeReturnDelay then
            lastRet = tick(); safeTeleport(getgenv().homePosition)
        end
    end)
end
getgenv().stopReturnHome = function() if homeConn then homeConn:Disconnect() homeConn = nil end end

getgenv().startSafeZone = function()
    if safeZoneConn then safeZoneConn:Disconnect() end
    safeZoneConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not getHrp() then return end
        if getHrp().Position.Y > config.safeZoneY then getgenv().safeZoneSavedPos = getHrp().Position
        elseif config.safeZoneEnabled and getgenv().safeZoneSavedPos then getHrp().CFrame = CFrame.new(getgenv().safeZoneSavedPos) end
    end)
end
getgenv().stopSafeZone = function() if safeZoneConn then safeZoneConn:Disconnect() safeZoneConn = nil end end

getgenv().startTeleportLoop = function()
    if loopConn then pcall(task.cancel, loopConn) end
    config.teleportLoopEnabled = true
    loopConn = task.spawn(function()
        while config.teleportLoopEnabled do
            if #getgenv().loopWaypoints > 0 and getHrp() then
                local t = getgenv().loopWaypoints[getgenv().loopIndex]
                if t then safeTeleport(t) end
                getgenv().loopIndex = (getgenv().loopIndex % #getgenv().loopWaypoints) + 1
            end
            task.wait(config.teleportLoopDelay)
        end
    end)
end
getgenv().stopTeleportLoop = function()
    config.teleportLoopEnabled = false
    if loopConn then pcall(task.cancel, loopConn) loopConn = nil end
end

local antiAfkConn = nil
getgenv().startAntiAfk = function()
    if antiAfkConn then antiAfkConn:Disconnect() end
    antiAfkConn = localplayer.Idled:Connect(function()
        if config.antiAfkEnabled then
            VirtualUser:Button2Down(Vector2.new(0, 0), workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame)
            task.wait(1)
            VirtualUser:Button2Up(Vector2.new(0, 0), workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame)
        end
    end)
end
getgenv().stopAntiAfk = function() if antiAfkConn then antiAfkConn:Disconnect() antiAfkConn = nil end end

local flyConn = nil
getgenv().startFly = function()
    if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect() end
    flyConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        local tHrp = getHrp()
        if not tHrp or not config.flyEnabled then return end
        local h = localplayer.Character and localplayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if h then h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics) end
        local c  = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local md = Vector3.zero
        if h and h.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
            local fl = Vector3.new(c.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, c.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
            md = fl.Magnitude > 0.001
                and Vector3.new(h.MoveDirection.X, c.CFrame.LookVector.Y * h.MoveDirection:Dot(fl.Unit), h.MoveDirection.Z)
                or  Vector3.new(h.MoveDirection.X, c.CFrame.LookVector.Y, h.MoveDirection.Z)
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then md = md + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then md = md - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        tHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero; tHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        if md.Magnitude > 0 then tHrp.CFrame = tHrp.CFrame + (md.Unit * (config.flySpeed * dt)) end
    end)
end
getgenv().stopFly = function()
    if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect() flyConn = nil end
    if getHrp() then getHrp().AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero; getHrp().AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end
    local h = localplayer.Character and localplayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if h then h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end
end

local underMapConn = nil
getgenv().startUnderMap = function()
    if underMapConn then underMapConn:Disconnect() end
    underMapConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not config.underMapEnabled or not getHrp() then return end
        local hrp = getHrp()
        if localplayer.Character then
            for _, p in ipairs(localplayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = false end
            end
        end
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position.X, config.underMapY, hrp.Position.Z)
    end)
end
getgenv().stopUnderMap = function() if underMapConn then underMapConn:Disconnect() underMapConn = nil end end

table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if config.nc and localplayer.Character then
        for _, p in ipairs(localplayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = false end
        end
    end
end))

table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if config.antiAimEnabled and getHrp() and getgenv().vercelAntiAim then pcall(getgenv().vercelAntiAim) end
    if config.spinEnabled and getHrp() then
        getHrp().CFrame = getHrp().CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(math.random(-180, 180)), 0)
        getHrp().AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-200, 200), 250, math.random(-200, 200)) * 45
    end
end))

-- ANTI AIM engine
do
    local aa = { mode = "Jitter", speed = 720, range = 90, away = false, flip = false, t = 0, pmode = "Manual", strafe = 0, roll = 0, maxDist = 0, threatAt = 0, threat = false }
    getgenv().vercelAA = aa
    getgenv().vercelAntiAim = function()
        local hrp = getHrp()
        local hum = localplayer.Character and localplayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hrp then return end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local baseYaw = select(2, cam.CFrame:ToOrientation())
        if aa.away then
            local foe = getClosest()
            local fr = foe and foe.Character and foe.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if fr then
                local d = hrp.Position - fr.Position
                baseYaw = math.atan2(-d.X, -d.Z)
            end
        end
        if aa.maxDist > 0 then
            local foe = getClosest()
            local fr = foe and foe.Character and foe.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not fr or (fr.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude > aa.maxDist then
                if hum then hum.AutoRotate = true end
                return
            end
        end
        aa.flip = not aa.flip
        -- is anybody aiming at me?
        if tick() - aa.threatAt > 0.1 then
            aa.threatAt = tick() aa.threat = false
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                local eh = p ~= localplayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if eh and eh.Position.Magnitude < 1e5 then
                    local to = hrp.Position - eh.Position
                    if to.Magnitude < 350 and to.Magnitude > 0.1 and eh.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(to.Unit) > 0.95 then aa.threat = true break end
                end
            end
        end
        local yawOff = math.rad(config.yawAngle or 0)
        local yaw
        local m = aa.mode
        if m == "Static" then yaw = baseYaw + yawOff
        elseif m == "Spin" then aa.t = aa.t + math.rad(aa.speed) / 60 yaw = aa.t
        elseif m == "Jitter" then yaw = baseYaw + yawOff + (aa.flip and 1 or -1) * math.rad(aa.range)
        elseif m == "Random" then yaw = math.rad(math.random(-180, 180))
        elseif m == "Sway" then aa.t = aa.t + math.rad(aa.speed) / 60 yaw = baseYaw + yawOff + math.sin(aa.t) * math.rad(aa.range)
        elseif m == "Desync 180" then yaw = baseYaw + yawOff + (aa.flip and 0 or math.pi)
        elseif m == "Smart" then
            if aa.threat then
                aa.t = aa.t + math.rad(1440) / 60
                yaw = aa.t + (math.random() - 0.5) * 2
            else
                yaw = baseYaw + yawOff + math.rad((math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * aa.range)
            end
        elseif m == "Freestand" then
            local foe = getClosest()
            local fr = foe and foe.Character and foe.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if fr then
                local d = hrp.Position - fr.Position
                yaw = math.atan2(-d.X, -d.Z) + math.pi / 2 * (aa.flip and 1 or -1) * 0.9
            else yaw = baseYaw + yawOff end
        else yaw = baseYaw + yawOff end
        local pitch = math.rad(config.pitchAngle or 0)
        if m == "Jitter" or m == "Random" then pitch = pitch + (aa.flip and 1 or -1) * math.rad(math.min(aa.range, 60)) * 0.5 end
        local pm = aa.pmode
        if pm == "Down" then pitch = math.rad(80) elseif pm == "Up" then pitch = math.rad(-80)
        elseif pm == "Jitter" then pitch = (aa.flip and 1 or -1) * math.rad(80)
        elseif pm == "Random" then pitch = math.rad(math.random(-80, 80)) end
        if aa.strafe > 0 then
            pcall(function()
                local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(v.X, v.Y, v.Z) + hrp.CFrame.RightVector * (aa.flip and 1 or -1) * aa.strafe
            end)
        end
        if hum then hum.AutoRotate = false end
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, math.rad(aa.roll) + ((m == "Jitter" or m == "Smart") and (aa.flip and 1 or -1) * math.rad(15) or 0))
    end
end

local function Tgl(box, id, txt, desc, cb)
    box:AddToggle(id, { Text = txt, Default = false, Callback = function(v) if v then Notify(txt, desc) end cb(v) end })
end
local function Sld(box, id, txt, def, min, max, rnd, cb)
    box:AddSlider(id, { Text = txt, Default = def, Min = min, Max = max, Rounding = rnd or 0, Callback = cb })
end

local AntiHitBox = CombatTab:AddRightGroupbox("Anti-Hit")
Tgl(AntiHitBox, "SlingRage", "Slingshot Ragebot", "Bypasses slingshot parameters.", function(v) config.slingRage = v if v then startSlingRage() else stopSlingRage() end end)
Tgl(AntiHitBox, "AntiProj",  "Anti Projectile",   "Freezes and breaks projectiles.", function(v) config.antiProj = v if v then startAntiProj() else stopAntiProj() end end)

local RiotAbuserBox = CombatTab:AddRightGroupbox("Riot Abuser")
Tgl(RiotAbuserBox, "RiotAbuserE", "Riot Abuser", "Heavy distortion parameters.", function(v) config.riotAbuserEnabled = v if v then startRiotAbuser() else stopRiotAbuser() end end)
Sld(RiotAbuserBox, "RA_D",    "Spread Distance", 300, 10, 1000, 0, function(v) config.riotAbuserDistance = v end)
Sld(RiotAbuserBox, "RA_X",    "X Jitter", 30, 0, 200, 0, function(v) config.riotAbuserX = v end)
Sld(RiotAbuserBox, "RA_Y",    "Y Jitter", 8, 0, 100, 0, function(v) config.riotAbuserY = v end)
Sld(RiotAbuserBox, "RA_Z",    "Z Jitter", 30, 0, 200, 0, function(v) config.riotAbuserZ = v end)
Sld(RiotAbuserBox, "RA_Spin", "Spin Speed", 720, 0, 2000, 0, function(v) config.riotAbuserSpin = v end)

local RiotBypassBox = CombatTab:AddRightGroupbox("Riot Bypass")
Tgl(RiotBypassBox, "RiotBypassE", "Riot Bypass", "Snap to target, facing them.", function(v) config.riotBypassEnabled = v if v then startRiotBypass() else stopRiotBypass() end end)
Sld(RiotBypassBox, "RB_D",  "Distance", 3, 0, 20, 1, function(v) config.riotBypassDistance = v end)
Sld(RiotBypassBox, "RB_H",  "Height Offset", 0, -20, 20, 1, function(v) config.riotBypassHeight = v end)
Sld(RiotBypassBox, "RB_UR", "Update Rate (ms)", 20, 1, 500, 0, function(v) config.riotBypassUpdate = v / 1000 end)
RiotBypassBox:AddDropdown("RB_Pos", { Text = "Teleport Position", Values = { "Front", "Back", "Above", "Below" }, Default = 1, Callback = function(v) config.riotBypassPosition = v end })

-- ANTI MELEE (anti-bait is always on)
do
    local rage = { team = true }
    local MELEE = { knife = true, katana = true, fists = true, scythe = true, daggers = true, chainsaw = true, ["battle axe"] = true, maul = true, trowel = true, sword = true, bat = true, axe = true, machete = true, ["paintball gun"] = false }
    local am = { on = false, range = 22, anyWeapon = false, rise = 0, last = 0 }
    local function alive(p)
        local ch = p.Character
        local h = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        return ch and h and h.Health > 0 and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and ch
    end
    local function enemy(p)
        if p == localplayer then return false end
        if rage.team and localplayer.Team ~= nil and p.Team == localplayer.Team then return false end
        return true
    end
    -- ANTI-BAIT: remember each enemy's recent positions; one that keeps teleporting is "void spamming"
    local hist, lastSpam = {}, {}
    local bait = { on = true, jump = 60, keep = 10, spamJumps = 2 }
    table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            local ch = p ~= localplayer and alive(p)
            if ch then
                local h = hist[p]
                if not h then h = {} hist[p] = h end
                h[#h + 1] = ch.HumanoidRootPart.Position
                if #h > bait.keep then table.remove(h, 1) end
                if #h >= 3 then
                    local jn = 0
                    for i = 2, #h do if (h[i] - h[i - 1]).Magnitude > bait.jump then jn = jn + 1 end end
                    if jn >= bait.spamJumps then lastSpam[p] = tick() end
                end
            else hist[p] = nil end
        end
    end))
    -- returns (position to use, isSpamming)
    local function stable(p, ch)
        local latest = ch.HumanoidRootPart.Position
        local h = hist[p]
        if not bait.on or not h or #h < 3 then return latest, false end
        local jumps = 0
        for i = 2, #h do if (h[i] - h[i - 1]).Magnitude > bait.jump then jumps = jumps + 1 end end
        return latest, jumps >= bait.spamJumps
    end
    am.skipBait = true
    getgenv().vercelIsBait = function(p) local ch = p and p.Character if not ch or not alive(p) then return false end local _, sp = stable(p, ch) return sp end
    -- ANTI MELEE: any enemy holding a melee weapon that gets close is dodged before it can swing
    local amConn
    local function isMelee(ch)
        if am.anyWeapon then return true end
        for _, t in ipairs(ch:GetChildren()) do
            if t:IsA("Tool") and MELEE[t.Name:lower()] then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function amStep()
        if not am.on then return end
        local hrp = getHrp()
        if not hrp or tick() - am.last < 0.02 then return end
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= localplayer and (localplayer.Team == nil or p.Team ~= localplayer.Team) then
                local ch = alive(p)
                local _, spamming = false, false
                if ch then _, spamming = stable(p, ch) end
                if ch and not (spamming and am.skipBait) and isMelee(ch) then
                    local er = ch.HumanoidRootPart
                    local off = hrp.Position - er.Position
                    if off.Magnitude <= am.range then
                        am.last = tick()
                        local away = off.Magnitude > 0.1 and off.Unit or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
                        local yaw = math.rad(math.random(-45, 45))
                        local dir = CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0):VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(away.X, 0, away.Z))
                        local newPos = er.Position + dir * (am.range + 14) + Vector3.new(0, am.rise, 0)
                        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(newPos, newPos + hrp.CFrame.LookVector)
                        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    getgenv().startAntiMelee = function() if amConn then amConn:Disconnect() end amConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(amStep) end
    getgenv().stopAntiMelee = function() am.on = false if amConn then amConn:Disconnect() amConn = nil end end
    local AmBox = CombatTab:AddRightGroupbox("Anti Melee")
    Tgl(AmBox, "AntiMeleeOn", "Anti Melee", "Dodges away from enemies with a melee weapon before they reach you.", function(v) am.on = v if v then startAntiMelee() else stopAntiMelee() end end)
    Sld(AmBox, "AmRange", "Trigger Range", 22, 6, 80, 0, function(v) am.range = v end)
    Sld(AmBox, "AmRise", "Extra Height", 0, 0, 60, 0, function(v) am.rise = v end)
    AmBox:AddButton({ Text = "ALL-IN: Anti Melee + Void Spam MAX", Func = function()
        pcall(function()
            Toggles.AntiMeleeOn:SetValue(true) Toggles.AmAny:SetValue(true)
            Toggles.VSMax:SetValue(true) Toggles.VSScatter:SetValue(true) Toggles.VSReturn:SetValue(true)
            Options.VSInterval:SetValue(1) Options.VSBurst:SetValue(400) Options.VSPattern:SetValue("mixed")
            Toggles.VoidSpamE:SetValue(true)
        end)
    end })
    AmBox:AddToggle("AmAny", { Text = "Dodge ANY close enemy (not just melee)", Default = false, Callback = function(v) am.anyWeapon = v end })

    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- LILAC COUNTER: bait (void spam) -> stops -> attacks. Scores each enemy, then
    -- dodges to a safe spot, boosts void spam, and escapes when hit.
    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    local lc = { counter = true, cRange = 90, cWindow = 3, aimDot = 0.8, hop = 20, hopRate = 0.04, minLevel = 2,
        boost = true, boostTime = 2, noise = true, noiseAmt = 80, preBoost = true, safeSpot = true, samples = 10,
        escape = true, escapeDist = 160, escapeClose = 22, panic = true, panicTime = 1.5, closing = 22 }
    local lcLastHop, lcLastEscape, damagedUntil, boostUntil, autoStarted = 0, 0, 0, 0, false
    local lcName, lcDist, lcLevel = nil, nil, 0
    local function isBait(p) return lastSpam[p] ~= nil and tick() - lastSpam[p] < 0.35 end
    local function rv()
        local v = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5)
        return v.Magnitude > 0.001 and v.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
    end
    local rp = RaycastParams.new()
    rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local lastFilter = 0
    local function refreshFilter()
        if tick() - lastFilter < 0.5 then return end
        lastFilter = tick()
        local list = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if p.Character then list[#list + 1] = p.Character end end
        rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = list
    end
    local function hookHealth(ch)
        local hum = ch:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
        if not hum then return end
        local last = hum.Health
        table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(h)
            if h < last and lc.panic then damagedUntil = tick() + lc.panicTime end
            last = h
        end))
    end
    if localplayer.Character then task.spawn(hookHealth, localplayer.Character) end
    table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, localplayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch) task.spawn(hookHealth, ch) end))

    local function enemyList(hrp)
        local list = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if enemy(p) then
                local ch = alive(p)
                if ch then
                    local er = ch.HumanoidRootPart
                    local off = hrp.Position - er.Position
                    local d = off.Magnitude
                    list[#list + 1] = { p = p, er = er, d = d, bait = isBait(p), dir = d > 0.1 and off.Unit or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), vel = er.AssemblyLinearVelocity, head = (ch:FindFirstChild("Head") or er).Position }
                end
            end
        end
        return list
    end
    local function scoreOf(e)
        if e.bait or e.d > lc.cRange or e.d < 0.1 then return 0 end
        local sc = 0
        if lastSpam[e.p] ~= nil and (tick() - lastSpam[e.p]) <= lc.cWindow then sc = sc + 3 end
        if e.er.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(e.dir) >= lc.aimDot and e.d <= lc.cRange * 0.7 then sc = sc + 2 end
        if e.vel:Dot(e.dir) >= lc.closing then sc = sc + 2 end
        if e.d <= lc.escapeClose then sc = sc + 2 end
        return sc
    end
    local function safeSpot(hrp, list, dist)
        refreshFilter()
        local best, bestScore
        for _ = 1, math.max(lc.safeSpot and lc.samples or 1, 1) do
            local ang = math.random() * math.pi * 2
            local dd = dist * (0.6 + math.random() * 0.8)
            local cand = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(ang) * dd, 0, math.sin(ang) * dd)
            local hit = workspace:Raycast(cand + Vector3.new(0, 80, 0), Vector3.new(0, -500, 0), rp)
            if hit then
                cand = hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0)
                local score, minD = 0, math.huge
                for _, e in ipairs(list) do
                    local d = (cand - e.er.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < minD then minD = d end
                    if lc.safeSpot and d <= 400 then
                        local look = e.er.CFrame.LookVector
                        local rel = cand - e.er.Position
                        local along = rel:Dot(look)
                        if along > 0 then
                            local perp = (rel - look * along).Magnitude
                            if perp < 12 then score = score - (12 - perp) * 3 end
                        end
                        if workspace:Raycast(e.head, cand - e.head, rp) then score = score + 45 end
                    end
                end
                score = score + math.min(minD, 150)
                if not bestScore or score > bestScore then best, bestScore = cand, score end
            end
        end
        return best
    end
    local function moveTo(hrp, pos)
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos, pos + hrp.CFrame.LookVector)
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end
    -- boosting uses the real void spam; it is turned back off afterwards unless you enabled it yourself
    local function boostOn()
        boostUntil = tick() + lc.boostTime
        if not config.voidSpamEnabled then
            config.voidSpamEnabled = true
            autoStarted = true
            pcall(startVoidSpam)
        end
    end
    table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if autoStarted and tick() > boostUntil then
            autoStarted = false
            local userOn = false
            pcall(function() userOn = Toggles.VoidSpamE.Value end)
            if not userOn then pcall(stopVoidSpam) end
        end
        lcName, lcLevel = nil, 0
        if not lc.counter then return end
        local hrp = getHrp()
        local hum = localplayer.Character and localplayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hrp or (hum and hum.Health <= 0) then return end
        local list = enemyList(hrp)
        if #list == 0 then return end
        if lc.preBoost and lc.boost then
            for _, e in ipairs(list) do
                if e.bait and e.d <= lc.cRange * 1.6 then boostOn() break end
            end
        end
        local top, topScore, nearest, total = nil, 0, nil, 0
        for _, e in ipairs(list) do
            local sc = scoreOf(e)
            total = total + sc
            if sc > topScore then top, topScore = e, sc end
            if not nearest or e.d < nearest.d then nearest = e end
        end
        local hurt = tick() < damagedUntil
        local level = topScore + (hurt and 4 or 0) + (total > topScore and 1 or 0)
        if level < lc.minLevel then return end
        local subject = top or nearest
        if not subject then return end
        lcName, lcDist, lcLevel = subject.p.Name, subject.d, level
        if lc.boost then boostOn() end
        local now = tick()
        if lc.escape and (hurt or level >= 5 or subject.d <= lc.escapeClose) and now - lcLastEscape >= 0.3 then
            lcLastEscape = now
            local spot = safeSpot(hrp, list, lc.escapeDist)
            if spot then moveTo(hrp, spot) return end
        end
        if now - lcLastHop >= lc.hopRate * (0.6 + math.random() * 0.8) then
            lcLastHop = now
            local spot = safeSpot(hrp, list, lc.hop)
            if spot then moveTo(hrp, spot) end
        end
        if lc.noise then hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = rv() * lc.noiseAmt end
    end))
    getgenv().stopLilac = function() lc.counter = false end

    local LcBox = CombatTab:AddRightGroupbox("Lilac Counter")
    LcBox:AddToggle("LCOn", { Text = "Lilac Counter", Default = true, Callback = function(v) lc.counter = v end })
    Tgl(LcBox, "LCPre", "Pre-boost when a nearby enemy void spams", "Your void spam goes full power before they attack.", function(v) lc.preBoost = v end)
    Tgl(LcBox, "LCBoost", "Auto void spam when threatened", "Turns void spam on during a threat, off afterwards.", function(v) lc.boost = v end)
    Tgl(LcBox, "LCSafe", "Smart safe spot (cover + off aim line)", "Dodges to the safest grounded spot.", function(v) lc.safeSpot = v end)
    Tgl(LcBox, "LCEsc", "Big escape when hit / enemy on top", "Long teleport away when it is about to land.", function(v) lc.escape = v end)
    Tgl(LcBox, "LCPanic", "Panic on taking damage", "Escapes the moment your health drops.", function(v) lc.panic = v end)
    Tgl(LcBox, "LCNoise", "Velocity noise while threatened", "Random velocity so prediction gets garbage.", function(v) lc.noise = v end)
    Sld(LcBox, "LCLevel", "Sensitivity (lower = reacts sooner)", 2, 1, 6, 0, function(v) lc.minLevel = v end)
    Sld(LcBox, "LCRange", "Threat range (studs)", 90, 20, 400, 0, function(v) lc.cRange = v end)
    Sld(LcBox, "LCWindow", "Bait->attack window (s)", 3, 0.5, 8, 1, function(v) lc.cWindow = v end)
    Sld(LcBox, "LCAim", "Aim cone (facing you)", 0.8, 0.5, 0.99, 2, function(v) lc.aimDot = v end)
    Sld(LcBox, "LCClose", "Approach speed trigger", 22, 5, 80, 0, function(v) lc.closing = v end)
    Sld(LcBox, "LCHop", "Evade hop distance", 20, 4, 80, 0, function(v) lc.hop = v end)
    Sld(LcBox, "LCHopRate", "Evade rate (s, lower = faster)", 0.04, 0.01, 0.3, 2, function(v) lc.hopRate = v end)
    Sld(LcBox, "LCEscDist", "Escape distance", 160, 50, 500, 0, function(v) lc.escapeDist = v end)
    Sld(LcBox, "LCEscClose", "Escape when enemy within", 22, 6, 60, 0, function(v) lc.escapeClose = v end)
    Sld(LcBox, "LCSamples", "Safe-spot samples", 10, 2, 24, 0, function(v) lc.samples = v end)
    Sld(LcBox, "LCPanicT", "Panic duration (s)", 1.5, 0.5, 5, 1, function(v) lc.panicTime = v end)
    Sld(LcBox, "LCBoostT", "Boost duration (s)", 2, 0.5, 6, 1, function(v) lc.boostTime = v end)
    Sld(LcBox, "LCNoiseAmt", "Velocity noise", 80, 0, 400, 0, function(v) lc.noiseAmt = v end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- UE COUNTER: a player that ONLY void spams (never attacks). The server sees their
    -- position jumping around, but the spot they keep coming back to is where they really
    -- are. We estimate that spot from the densest cluster of their recent positions, mark
    -- it, and can aim / fire / stick at it instead of at the fake positions.
    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    local ue = { on = true, mark = true, aim = true, fire = false, stick = false, range = 500, radius = 14, window = 1.2,
        smooth = 0.35, tol = 5, rate = 0.08, stickDist = 4, keep = 30 }
    local uh, ueEst, ueMark = {}, {}, {}
    local lastEst, lastFire = 0, 0
    local function spamming(p) return lastSpam[p] ~= nil and tick() - lastSpam[p] <= ue.window end
    local function estimate(h)
        if not h or #h < 6 then return nil end
        local R = ue.radius
        local bestI, bestN = 1, -1
        for i = 1, #h do
            local n = 0
            for j = 1, #h do if (h[i] - h[j]).Magnitude <= R then n = n + 1 end end
            if n > bestN then bestN, bestI = n, i end
        end
        local sum, c = Vector3.new(), 0
        for j = 1, #h do if (h[bestI] - h[j]).Magnitude <= R then sum = sum + h[j] c = c + 1 end end
        return sum / c, bestN / #h
    end
    local function dropMark(p)
        local m = ueMark[p]
        if m then pcall(function() m:Destroy() end) ueMark[p] = nil end
    end
    local function getMark(p)
        local m = ueMark[p]
        if m and m.Parent then return m end
        m = Instance.new("Part")
        m.Name = "UEMark" m.Anchored = true m.CanCollide = false m.CanQuery = false m.CanTouch = false m.Transparency = 1 m.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
        local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        gui.AlwaysOnTop = true gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 46) gui.Adornee = m gui.Parent = m
        local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
        dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5) dot.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5) dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14)
        dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(212, 168, 98) dot.BorderSizePixel = 0 dot.Parent = gui
        local c = Instance.new("UICorner") c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) c.Parent = dot
        local st = Instance.new("UIStroke") st.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) st.Thickness = 2 st.Parent = dot
        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1 lbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 26) lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16) lbl.Text = "UE" lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold lbl.TextSize = 12
        lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(212, 168, 98) lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3 lbl.Parent = gui
        m.Parent = workspace
        ueMark[p] = m
        return m
    end
    -- history + estimate (estimate refreshed 20x per second)
    table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local hrp = getHrp()
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            local ch = p ~= localplayer and enemy(p) and alive(p)
            if ch and hrp then
                local h = uh[p]
                if not h then h = {} uh[p] = h end
                h[#h + 1] = ch.HumanoidRootPart.Position
                if #h > ue.keep then table.remove(h, 1) end
            else
                uh[p] = nil ueEst[p] = nil dropMark(p)
            end
        end
        if tick() - lastEst < 0.05 then return end
        lastEst = tick()
        for p, h in pairs(uh) do
            if ue.on and spamming(p) and hrp then
                local pos = estimate(h)
                if pos and (pos - hrp.Position).Magnitude <= ue.range then
                    ueEst[p] = pos
                    if ue.mark then getMark(p).Position = pos else dropMark(p) end
                else ueEst[p] = nil dropMark(p) end
            else ueEst[p] = nil dropMark(p) end
        end
    end))
    local function ueClick()
        pcall(function()
            local t = localplayer.Character and localplayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if t then t:Activate() end
            if mouse1click then mouse1click() end
        end)
    end
    -- aim (hold right mouse) + auto fire when the crosshair is on the estimated spot + optional stick
    table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not ue.on then return end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return end
        local vp = cam.ViewportSize / 2
        local ray = cam:ViewportPointToRay(vp.X, vp.Y)
        local bestPos, bestOff = nil, math.huge
        for _, pos in pairs(ueEst) do
            local rel = pos - ray.Origin
            local along = rel:Dot(ray.Direction)
            if along > 0 then
                local off = (rel - ray.Direction * along).Magnitude
                if off < bestOff then bestOff, bestPos = off, pos end
            end
        end
        if not bestPos then return end
        if ue.aim and UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then
            cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, bestPos), math.clamp(ue.smooth, 0.05, 1))
        end
        if ue.fire and bestOff <= ue.tol and tick() - lastFire >= ue.rate then
            lastFire = tick()
            ueClick()
        end
        if ue.stick then
            local hrp = getHrp()
            if hrp then
                local away = hrp.Position - bestPos
                away = Vector3.new(away.X, 0, away.Z)
                away = away.Magnitude > 0.1 and away.Unit or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
                local np = bestPos + away * ue.stickDist
                hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(np, Vector3.new(bestPos.X, np.Y, bestPos.Z))
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end
        end
    end))
    getgenv().stopUE = function() ue.on = false for p in pairs(ueMark) do dropMark(p) end end

    local UeBox = CombatTab:AddRightGroupbox("UE Counter")
    UeBox:AddToggle("UEOn", { Text = "UE Counter (void-spam-only players)", Default = true, Callback = function(v) ue.on = v if not v then for p in pairs(ueMark) do dropMark(p) end end end })
    UeBox:AddToggle("UEMark", { Text = "Mark their real spot", Default = true, Callback = function(v) ue.mark = v end })
    UeBox:AddToggle("UEAim", { Text = "Aim at real spot (hold right mouse)", Default = true, Callback = function(v) ue.aim = v end })
    UeBox:AddToggle("UEFire", { Text = "Auto fire when crosshair is on it", Default = false, Callback = function(v) ue.fire = v end })
    UeBox:AddToggle("UEStick", { Text = "Stick next to real spot (melee)", Default = false, Callback = function(v) ue.stick = v end })
    Sld(UeBox, "UERange", "Range (studs)", 500, 50, 2000, 0, function(v) ue.range = v end)
    Sld(UeBox, "UERadius", "Cluster radius (studs)", 14, 4, 50, 0, function(v) ue.radius = v end)
    Sld(UeBox, "UEWindow", "Counts as spamming for (s)", 1.2, 0.3, 4, 1, function(v) ue.window = v end)
    Sld(UeBox, "UESmooth", "Aim smoothness", 0.35, 0.05, 1, 2, function(v) ue.smooth = v end)
    Sld(UeBox, "UETol", "Fire tolerance (studs)", 5, 1, 20, 0, function(v) ue.tol = v end)
    Sld(UeBox, "UERate", "Fire delay (ms)", 80, 20, 500, 0, function(v) ue.rate = v / 1000 end)
    Sld(UeBox, "UEStickD", "Stick distance", 4, 1, 15, 0, function(v) ue.stickDist = v end)
end

-- AIM ASSIST / TRIGGERBOT (native)
local aimCfg = { assist = false, fov = 120, smooth = 0.25, part = "Head", team = true, trig = false, trigDelay = 0.1, showFov = false }
local fovCircle
pcall(function()
    if Drawing then
        fovCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
        fovCircle.Thickness = 1; fovCircle.NumSides = 64; fovCircle.Filled = false
        fovCircle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170); fovCircle.Visible = false
    end
end)
local function isEnemy(p)
    if p == localplayer then return false end
    local wl = getgenv().EtherealWhite
    if wl and (wl[p.Name:lower()] or wl[p.DisplayName:lower()]) then return false end
    if aimCfg.team and localplayer.Team ~= nil and p.Team == localplayer.Team then return false end
    local ch = p.Character
    local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return hum ~= nil and hum.Health > 0
end
local lastTrig = 0
table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    local mpos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    if fovCircle then
        fovCircle.Visible = aimCfg.showFov and aimCfg.assist
        fovCircle.Position = mpos; fovCircle.Radius = aimCfg.fov
    end
    if aimCfg.assist and UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then
        local best, bestD = nil, aimCfg.fov
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if isEnemy(p) and not (getgenv().vercelIsBait and getgenv().vercelIsBait(p)) then
                local part = p.Character:FindFirstChild(aimCfg.part) or p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if part then
                    local sp, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                    if on then
                        local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - mpos).Magnitude
                        if d < bestD then bestD = d; best = part end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if best then
            local goal = CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, best.Position)
            cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(goal, math.clamp(aimCfg.smooth, 0.02, 1))
        end
    end
    if aimCfg.trig and (tick() - lastTrig) >= aimCfg.trigDelay then
        local ray = cam:ViewportPointToRay(mpos.X, mpos.Y)
        local rp = RaycastParams.new()
        rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { localplayer.Character }
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 1000, rp)
        local m = hit and hit.Instance and hit.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        local p = m and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m)
        if p and isEnemy(p) then
            lastTrig = tick()
            pcall(function()
                if mouse1click then mouse1click() else VirtualUser:ClickButton1(mpos) end
            end)
        end
    end
end))

local AimBox = CombatTab:AddLeftGroupbox("Aim Assist")
Tgl(AimBox, "AimAssistE", "Aim Assist", "Hold right mouse to pull aim to the nearest enemy.", function(v) aimCfg.assist = v end)
Sld(AimBox, "AimFov", "FOV", 120, 20, 600, 0, function(v) aimCfg.fov = v end)
Sld(AimBox, "AimSmooth", "Smoothing (higher = snappier)", 0.25, 0.02, 1, 2, function(v) aimCfg.smooth = v end)
AimBox:AddDropdown("AimPart", { Text = "Target Part", Values = { "Head", "HumanoidRootPart" }, Default = 1, Callback = function(v) aimCfg.part = v end })
AimBox:AddToggle("AimTeam", { Text = "Team Check", Default = true, Callback = function(v) aimCfg.team = v end })
AimBox:AddToggle("AimShowFov", { Text = "Show FOV Circle", Default = false, Callback = function(v) aimCfg.showFov = v end })
local TrigBox = CombatTab:AddRightGroupbox("Triggerbot")
Tgl(TrigBox, "TrigE", "Triggerbot", "Clicks when your crosshair is on an enemy.", function(v) aimCfg.trig = v end)
Sld(TrigBox, "TrigDelay", "Delay (ms)", 100, 0, 1000, 0, function(v) aimCfg.trigDelay = v / 1000 end)

do
local __mok, __merr = pcall(function()
-- AIMBOT / SILENT AIM / RAGEBOT
local ab = { touch = false, on = false, key = (UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.MouseEnabled) and "Always" or "Right Mouse", fov = 180, smooth = 0.45, mode = "Exponential", part = "Head", pred = 0, wall = true, sticky = false, human = 0, dead = 0, auto = false, autoDelay = 0.08, showFov = false, ping = true, target = nil, lastAuto = 0 }
local sa = { on = false, fov = 220, part = "Head", hit = 100, wall = true, pred = 0 }
local rb = { on = false, spam = true, range = 900, part = "Head", mode = "Closest", rate = 0.05, wall = false, pred = 0.1, hotkey = "None", silent = true, hold = false, resolver = true, tpDist = 45, lock = 250, ffIgnore = true, move = "None", moveR = 14, moveSpd = 4, spamWas = nil, last = 0, holding = false, target = nil, targetAt = 0, ang = 0, hitscan = true, ping = true, burst = 1, spamPref = "Any", slot = "None", pat = "Keep", boostBurst = 0, savedPat = nil, savedBurst = nil, adapt = true, shots = 0, sinceHit = 0, hits = 0, partRot = 0, predBoost = 0, lastHp = nil, lastTarget = nil, holdAcc = 0, statLabel = nil, kills = 0, notify = true, giveUp = 4, skip = {}, lastHitAt = 0, fireVis = false, smooth = 0, white = {}, watch = nil, killLabel = nil }
local silentPart, silentPos
local abMouse = localplayer:GetMouse()
local track = {}
local AUTO = { "Head", "UpperTorso", "HumanoidRootPart", "LowerTorso" }
local ROT = {}
for k = 0, 3 do
    local t = {}
    for i = 1, 4 do t[i] = AUTO[((i - 1 + k) % 4) + 1] end
    ROT[k] = t
end
local pingMs, pingAt = 0, 0
local function pingComp()
    if tick() - pingAt > 0.5 then
        pingAt = tick()
        pcall(function() pingMs = game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue() end)
    end
    return math.clamp(pingMs, 0, 400) / 2000
end
local abCircle
pcall(function()
    if Drawing then
        abCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
        abCircle.Thickness = 1 abCircle.NumSides = 64 abCircle.Filled = false abCircle.Visible = false
        abCircle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(212, 160, 90)
    end
end)

local function enemyPart(p, name)
    local ch = p.Character
    return ch and (ch:FindFirstChild(name) or ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
end
local function aimPos(part, t)
    if not part then return nil end
    local v = Vector3.zero
    pcall(function() v = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity end)
    return part.Position + v * (t or 0)
end
local function aimPoint()
    if UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.MouseEnabled then
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam then return cam.ViewportSize / 2 end
    end
    return UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
end
local visC = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local visiblePos
local function visCached(cam, pos, p, nm)
    local pt = visC[p]
    if not pt then pt = {} visC[p] = pt end
    local e, now = pt[nm], tick()
    if e and now - e[1] < 0.08 then return e[2] end
    local v = visiblePos(cam, pos, p.Character)
    if e then e[1] = now e[2] = v else pt[nm] = { now, v } end
    return v
end
function visiblePos(cam, pos, ch)
    local rp = RaycastParams.new()
    rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { localplayer.Character, ch }
    local o = cam.CFrame.Position
    return workspace:Raycast(o, pos - o, rp) == nil
end
local function pickByScreen(fov, partName, wall)
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return nil end
    local mpos = aimPoint()
    local best, bestD = nil, fov
    local names = partName == "Auto" and AUTO or { partName }
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if isEnemy(p) and not (getgenv().vercelIsBait and getgenv().vercelIsBait(p)) then
            for _, nm in ipairs(names) do
                local part = enemyPart(p, nm)
                if part then
                    local sp, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                    if on then
                        local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - mpos).Magnitude
                        if d < bestD and (not wall or visCached(cam, part.Position, p, nm)) then bestD, best = d, part end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end
local function keyHeld(k)
    if k == "Always" then return true end
    if k == "On-screen button" then return ab.touch end
    if k == "Left Mouse" then return UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) end
    return UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2)
end
local function click()
    local ok = pcall(function()
        if mouse1click then mouse1click() else error("no mouse1click") end
    end)
    if ok then return end
    pcall(function()
        local vim = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
        local p = aimPoint()
        vim:SendMouseButtonEvent(p.X, p.Y, 0, true, game, 0)
        vim:SendMouseButtonEvent(p.X, p.Y, 0, false, game, 0)
    end)
    pcall(function() VirtualUser:ClickButton1(aimPoint()) end)
end
local function setVoidSpam(on)
    pcall(function()
        if Toggles.VoidSpamE then Toggles.VoidSpamE:SetValue(on)
        else config.voidSpamEnabled = on if on then startVoidSpam() else stopVoidSpam() end end
    end)
end

-- position history + void-spam resolver --------------------------------------
local function sampleTracks(now)
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= localplayer then
            local hrp = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                local h = track[p]
                if not h then h = {} track[p] = h end
                h[#h + 1] = { now, hrp.Position }
                if #h > 60 then table.remove(h, 1) end
            else
                track[p] = nil
            end
        end
    end
end
-- returns best estimate of where `part` really is, and whether the player is void spamming
local function resolve(p, part, now)
    local h = track[p]
    if not rb.resolver or not h or #h < 6 then return aimPos(part, rb.pred + rb.predBoost + (rb.ping and pingComp() or 0)), false end
    local tp, vsum, vn = 0, Vector3.zero, 0
    for i = #h, 2, -1 do
        local a, b = h[i - 1], h[i]
        if now - b[1] > 0.9 then break end
        local step = (b[2] - a[2]).Magnitude
        if step > rb.tpDist then
            tp = tp + 1
        else
            local dt = b[1] - a[1]
            if dt > 0 and vn < 8 then vsum = vsum + (b[2] - a[2]) / dt vn = vn + 1 end
        end
    end
    if tp < 2 then
        local v = vn > 0 and (vsum / vn) or Vector3.zero
        if v.Magnitude > 120 then v = v.Unit * 120 end
        return part.Position + v * (rb.pred + rb.predBoost + (rb.ping and pingComp() or 0)), false
    end
    local cell, buckets, bestK, bestW = 8, {}, nil, 0
    for i = #h, 1, -1 do
        local e = h[i]
        local age = now - e[1]
        if age > 1.2 then break end
        local q = e[2]
        if q.Magnitude < 1e5 then
            local k = math.floor(q.X / cell) .. "," .. math.floor(q.Y / cell) .. "," .. math.floor(q.Z / cell)
            local b = buckets[k]
            if not b then b = { w = 0, sum = Vector3.zero } buckets[k] = b end
            local w = 1 + (1.2 - age)
            b.w = b.w + w b.sum = b.sum + q * w
            if b.w > bestW then bestW, bestK = b.w, k end
        end
    end
    local b = bestK and buckets[bestK]
    if b and bestW >= 3 then
        local off = part.Position - h[#h][2]
        if off.Magnitude > 20 then off = Vector3.zero end
        return b.sum / b.w + off, true
    end
    return part.Position, true
end

local function bestPart(cam, p, now)
    local names = (rb.part == "Auto") and (rb.adapt and ROT[rb.partRot] or AUTO) or { rb.part }
    local fp, fpos, fspam
    for _, nm in ipairs(names) do
        local part = enemyPart(p, nm)
        if part then
            local pos, spam = resolve(p, part, now)
            if not fp then fp, fpos, fspam = part, pos, spam end
            if rb.part ~= "Auto" or visCached(cam, pos, p, nm) then return part, pos, spam end
        end
    end
    return fp, fpos, fspam
end

local function rageTarget(cam, now)
    local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
    local mpos = aimPoint()
    local best, bestV, bestPos, bestPart, bestSpam, bestPlr = nil, math.huge, nil, nil, false, nil
    local cur = rb.target
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if isEnemy(p) and not (getgenv().vercelIsBait and getgenv().vercelIsBait(p)) and not (rb.skip[p] and now < rb.skip[p]) then
            local ch = p.Character
            local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local part, pos, spam
            if hum and not (rb.ffIgnore and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField")) then part, pos, spam = bestPart(cam, p, now) end
            if part and hum then
                local dist = (pos - origin).Magnitude
                if dist <= rb.range and (not rb.wall or visCached(cam, pos, p, "_T")) then
                    local v = dist
                    if rb.mode == "Lowest HP" then
                        v = hum.Health
                    elseif rb.mode == "Crosshair" then
                        local sp, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(pos)
                        v = on and (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - mpos).Magnitude or 5000 + dist
                    elseif rb.mode == "Threat" then
                        local hrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        local aimed = 0
                        if hrp then aimed = math.max(0, hrp.CFrame.LookVector:Dot((origin - hrp.Position).Unit)) end
                        v = dist * (2 - aimed)
                    end
                    if rb.spamPref == "Prefer spammers" and spam then v = v * 0.5 elseif rb.spamPref == "Avoid spammers" and spam then v = v * 3 end
                    if p == cur then
                        v = v * 0.6
                        if now - rb.targetAt < rb.lock / 1000 then v = -1 end
                    end
                    if v < bestV then bestV, best, bestPos, bestPart, bestSpam, bestPlr = v, p, pos, part, spam, p end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if bestPlr ~= cur then
        rb.target = bestPlr rb.targetAt = now
        local hum = bestPlr and bestPlr.Character and bestPlr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum and rb.watch ~= hum then
            rb.watch = hum
            local who = bestPlr.Name
            hum.Died:Connect(function()
                if rb.on and rb.target and rb.target.Name == who then
                    rb.kills = rb.kills + 1
                    if rb.notify then Notify("Ragebot", "Eliminated " .. who .. "  (" .. rb.kills .. ")") end
                    if rb.killLabel then pcall(function() rb.killLabel:SetText("Eliminations: " .. rb.kills) end) end
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    return bestPlr, bestPos, bestPart, bestSpam
end

local function fireControl(on)
    if rb.hold and mouse1press and mouse1release then
        if on and not rb.holding then pcall(mouse1press) rb.holding = true
        elseif not on and rb.holding then pcall(mouse1release) rb.holding = false end
    else
        if rb.holding then pcall(function() if mouse1release then mouse1release() end end) rb.holding = false end
        if on and tick() - rb.last >= rb.rate then rb.last = tick() for _ = 1, rb.burst do click() end rb.shots = rb.shots + rb.burst rb.sinceHit = rb.sinceHit + rb.burst end
    end
end

local function smoothAim(cam, goalPos, dt)
    local cf = cam.CFrame
    local want = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position, goalPos)
    local ang = math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(cf.LookVector:Dot(want.LookVector), -1, 1)))
    if ang < ab.dead then return ang end
    local a
    if ab.mode == "Constant" then a = ang > 0 and math.clamp((ab.smooth * 900 * dt) / ang, 0, 1) or 1
    elseif ab.mode == "Exponential" then a = 1 - math.exp(-ab.smooth * 18 * dt)
    else a = math.clamp(ab.smooth, 0.02, 1) end
    if ab.human > 0 then
        want = want * CFrame.Angles(math.rad((math.random() - 0.5) * ab.human * 0.4), math.rad((math.random() - 0.5) * ab.human * 0.4), 0)
    end
    cam.CFrame = cf:Lerp(want, math.clamp(a, 0.01, 1))
    return ang * (1 - math.clamp(a, 0.01, 1))
end

local function rageFrame(dt)
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    local now = tick()
    if rb.on then sampleTracks(now) elseif next(track) then track = {} end
    silentPart, silentPos = nil, nil
    if abCircle then
        abCircle.Visible = ab.showFov and ab.on
        abCircle.Position = aimPoint() abCircle.Radius = ab.fov
    end
    if sa.on and math.random(1, 100) <= sa.hit then
        local part = pickByScreen(sa.fov, sa.part, sa.wall)
        if part then silentPart, silentPos = part, aimPos(part, sa.pred) end
    end
    if ab.on and keyHeld(ab.key) then
        local t = ab.target
        local hum = t and t.Parent and t.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not (ab.sticky and hum and hum.Health > 0) then t = pickByScreen(ab.fov, ab.part, ab.wall) end
        ab.target = t
        if t then
            local left = smoothAim(cam, aimPos(t, ab.pred + (ab.ping and pingComp() or 0)), dt)
            if ab.auto and left < 1.5 and now - ab.lastAuto >= ab.autoDelay then ab.lastAuto = now click() end
        end
    else
        ab.target = nil
    end
    if rb.on then
        local plr, pos, part = rageTarget(cam, now)
        getgenv().EtherealRageTarget = plr
        if plr ~= rb.lastTarget then rb.lastTarget = plr rb.lastHp = nil rb.sinceHit = 0 rb.predBoost = 0 end
        if plr then
            local hum = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then
                if rb.lastHp and hum.Health < rb.lastHp - 0.5 then rb.hits = rb.hits + 1 rb.sinceHit = 0 rb.lastHitAt = now end
                rb.lastHp = hum.Health
            end
            if rb.hold and rb.holding then
                rb.holdAcc = rb.holdAcc + dt
                if rb.holdAcc >= 0.08 then rb.holdAcc = 0 rb.shots = rb.shots + 1 rb.sinceHit = rb.sinceHit + 1 end
            end
            if rb.giveUp > 0 and now - math.max(rb.targetAt, rb.lastHitAt) > rb.giveUp then
                rb.skip[plr] = now + 2.5
                rb.target = nil
                rb.lastTarget = nil
            end
            if rb.adapt and rb.sinceHit >= 14 then
                rb.sinceHit = 0
                rb.partRot = (rb.partRot + 1) % 4
                rb.predBoost = (rb.predBoost + 0.025 > 0.101) and 0 or (rb.predBoost + 0.025)
            end
            if rb.statLabel and now - (rb.statAt or 0) > 1 then
                rb.statAt = now
                pcall(function() rb.statLabel:SetText("Hits " .. rb.hits .. " / shots " .. rb.shots) end)
            end
        end
        if plr and pos then
            if rb.smooth > 0 then
                cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, pos), math.clamp(1 - rb.smooth, 0.05, 1))
            else
                cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, pos)
            end
            if rb.silent then silentPart, silentPos = part, pos end
            fireControl(not rb.fireVis or visCached(cam, pos, plr, "_F"))
        else
            fireControl(false)
        end
    elseif rb.holding then
        fireControl(false)
    end
end
do
    local ok = pcall(function() RunService:BindToRenderStep("EtherealRage", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, rageFrame) end)
    if not ok then table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(rageFrame)) end
end

-- ragebot movement (orbit / behind), only when void spam is not driving the character
table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    if not rb.on or rb.move == "None" or (rb.spam and config.voidSpamEnabled) then return end
    local plr = rb.target
    local tch = plr and plr.Character
    local thrp = tch and tch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hrp = getHrp()
    if not (thrp and hrp) then return end
    local tp = thrp.Position
    local pos
    if rb.move == "Orbit" then
        rb.ang = rb.ang + rb.moveSpd * dt
        pos = tp + Vector3.new(math.cos(rb.ang), 0, math.sin(rb.ang)) * rb.moveR
    else
        pos = tp - thrp.CFrame.LookVector * math.max(3, rb.moveR * 0.4)
    end
    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(pos.X, tp.Y, pos.Z), tp)
end))

-- silent aim hooks (redirect raycasts / mouse.Hit made by the game's own scripts)
pcall(function()
    if not (hookmetamethod and getnamecallmethod and newcclosure) then return end
    local checkc = checkcaller or function() return false end
    local oldNC
    oldNC = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(self, ...)
        local pos = silentPos
        if pos and self == workspace and not checkc() then
            local m = getnamecallmethod()
            if m == "Raycast" then
                local o, d = ...
                if typeof(o) == "Vector3" and typeof(d) == "Vector3" then
                    local rest = table.pack(...)
                    rest[2] = (pos - o).Unit * d.Magnitude
                    return oldNC(self, table.unpack(rest, 1, rest.n))
                end
            elseif m == "FindPartOnRay" or m == "FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList" or m == "FindPartOnRayWithWhitelist" then
                local ray = ...
                if typeof(ray) == "Ray" then
                    local rest = table.pack(...)
                    rest[1] = Ray.new(ray.Origin, (pos - ray.Origin).Unit * ray.Direction.Magnitude)
                    return oldNC(self, table.unpack(rest, 1, rest.n))
                end
            end
        end
        return oldNC(self, ...)
    end))
    local oldIdx
    oldIdx = hookmetamethod(game, "__index", newcclosure(function(self, k)
        local pos, part = silentPos, silentPart
        if pos and self == abMouse and not checkc() then
            if k == "Hit" then return CFrame.new(pos) end
            if k == "Target" then return part end
        end
        return oldIdx(self, k)
    end))
end)

local function rageSet(v)
    rb.on = v
    if v then
        if rb.pat ~= "Keep" then rb.savedPat = config.voidPattern config.voidPattern = rb.pat end
        if rb.boostBurst > 0 then rb.savedBurst = config.voidSpamBurst config.voidSpamBurst = rb.boostBurst end
        if rb.slot ~= "None" then
            pcall(function()
                local vim = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
                local kc = Enum.KeyCode[({ ["1"] = "One", ["2"] = "Two", ["3"] = "Three", ["4"] = "Four", ["5"] = "Five" })[rb.slot]]
                vim:SendKeyEvent(true, kc, false, game) task.wait(0.05) vim:SendKeyEvent(false, kc, false, game)
            end)
        end
    else
        if rb.savedPat then config.voidPattern = rb.savedPat rb.savedPat = nil end
        if rb.savedBurst then config.voidSpamBurst = rb.savedBurst rb.savedBurst = nil end
    end
    if v and rb.spam then
        rb.spamWas = config.voidSpamEnabled and true or false
        if not rb.spamWas then setVoidSpam(true) end
    elseif not v then
        if rb.spamWas == false then setVoidSpam(false) end
        rb.spamWas = nil
        rb.target = nil
    end
    getgenv().EtherealRageTarget = nil
    Notify("Ragebot", v and "ON" or "OFF")
end

-- UTILITIES
-- SPINBOT / BHOP / INFINITE JUMP / ANTI-AFK
do
local __mok, __merr = pcall(function()
    local sp = { on = false, mode = "Spin", speed = 1080, jit = 120, was = false }
    local bh = { on = false }
    local ij = { on = false }
    local cs = { on = false, speed = 60 }
    table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        local ch = localplayer.Character
        local hrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not (hrp and hum) then return end
        if sp.on then
            sp.was = true
            hum.AutoRotate = false
            if sp.mode == "Spin" then
                hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(sp.speed * dt), 0)
            elseif sp.mode == "Jitter" then
                local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                local yaw = select(2, cam.CFrame:ToOrientation()) + math.rad((math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * sp.jit)
                hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
            else
                local e = getClosest()
                local ehrp = e and e.Character and e.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if ehrp then
                    local d = hrp.Position - ehrp.Position
                    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + Vector3.new(d.X, 0, d.Z))
                end
            end
        elseif sp.was then
            sp.was = false
            hum.AutoRotate = true
        end
        if cs.on and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + hum.MoveDirection * (cs.speed * dt) end
        if bh.on and UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) and hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
            hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        end
    end))
    table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
        if ij.on then
            local hum = localplayer.Character and localplayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end
        end
    end))
    table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, localplayer.Idled:Connect(function()
        pcall(function() VirtualUser:CaptureController() VirtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new()) end)
    end))
    pcall(function() Library:OnUnload(function() sp.on = false end) end)

    local SB = MovementTab:AddRightGroupbox("Spinbot")
    Tgl(SB, "SpinbotE", "Spinbot", "Spins your character (not your camera).", function(v) sp.on = v end)
    SB:AddDropdown("SpinbotMode", { Text = "Mode", Values = { "Spin", "Jitter", "Look away" }, Default = 1, Callback = function(v) sp.mode = v end })
    Sld(SB, "SpinbotSpd", "Spin speed (deg/s)", 1080, 60, 5000, 0, function(v) sp.speed = v end)
    Sld(SB, "SpinbotJit", "Jitter range (deg)", 120, 10, 180, 0, function(v) sp.jit = v end)
    local MB = MovementTab:AddRightGroupbox("Movement +")

    Tgl(MB, "CSpeedE", "CFrame speed", "Moves you along your walk direction (bypasses WalkSpeed).", function(v) cs.on = v end)
    Sld(MB, "CSpeedV", "CFrame speed (studs/s)", 60, 10, 400, 0, function(v) cs.speed = v end)

if not __mok then warn("[ethereal] module error: " .. tostring(__merr)) end
