-- SKIN TOOLS (best effort, client side)
do
local __mok, __merr = pcall(function()
    local FLAGS_TRUE = { "Owned", "Unlocked", "IsOwned", "IsUnlocked", "Purchased", "Equipped_Allowed", "Available", "Obtained", "Has", "Owns", "CanUse", "CanEquip", "Equippable" }
    local FLAGS_FALSE = { "Locked", "IsLocked", "Hidden", "Restricted", "Limited_Locked" }
    local NAMEKEYS = { "Name", "DisplayName", "SkinName", "Rarity", "Skin", "Id", "ID", "Image", "Icon" }
    local PAT = { "skin", "cosmetic", "wrap", "inventory", "owned", "unlock", "loadout", "customiz", "locker" }
    local function say(t, d) Notify(t, d) end

    local function matchesName(n)
        n = tostring(n):lower()
        for _, p in ipairs(PAT) do if n:find(p, 1, true) then return true end end
        return false
    end

    local function scan()
        local out, n = {}, 0
        local roots = { game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), localplayer }
        pcall(function() table.insert(roots, localplayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")) end)
        for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
            if root then
                for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                    if matchesName(d.Name) then
                        n = n + 1
                        if n <= 400 then out[#out + 1] = d.ClassName .. "  " .. d:GetFullName() end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local gcHits = 0
        if getgc then
            pcall(function()
                for _, t in ipairs(getgc(true)) do
                    if type(t) == "table" then
                        local ok, hit = pcall(function()
                            for _, k in ipairs(FLAGS_TRUE) do if rawget(t, k) ~= nil then return true end end
                            return false
                        end)
                        if ok and hit then
                            gcHits = gcHits + 1
                            if gcHits <= 60 then
                                local keys = {}
                                pcall(function() for k, v in pairs(t) do if #keys < 8 then keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. "=" .. tostring(v) end end end)
                                out[#out + 1] = "TABLE  " .. table.concat(keys, ", ")
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        local report = "instances: " .. n .. "  tables: " .. gcHits .. "\n" .. table.concat(out, "\n")
        pcall(function() if writefile then writefile("ethereal/skin_scan.txt", report) end end)
        say("Skin scan", n .. " matching instances, " .. gcHits .. " item tables. Saved to ethereal/skin_scan.txt")
    end

    local FILE = "ethereal/skins.json"
    local saved = { unlock = false, owned = {} }
    pcall(function()
        if isfile and isfile(FILE) then
            local d = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(FILE))
            if type(d) == "table" then saved.unlock = d.unlock and true or false saved.owned = type(d.owned) == "table" and d.owned or {} end
        end
    end)
    local function persist()
        pcall(function()
            if writefile then
                pcall(function() if makefolder and isfolder and not isfolder("ethereal") then makefolder("ethereal") end end)
                writefile(FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(saved))
            end
        end)
    end
    local function itemName(t)
        for _, k in ipairs({ "Name", "DisplayName", "SkinName", "Id", "ID" }) do
            local v = rawget(t, k)
            if v ~= nil then return tostring(v) end
        end
    end
    local snapT = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })   -- item table -> { flag = original value }
    local snapV = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })   -- BoolValue -> original value
    local hadOwned = next(saved.owned) ~= nil
    local active = false

    local function eachItem(fn)
        local seen = {}
        local function visit(t)
            if seen[t] then return end
            seen[t] = true
            pcall(function()
                for _, k in ipairs(NAMEKEYS) do if rawget(t, k) ~= nil then fn(t) break end end
            end)
        end
        if getgc then
            pcall(function()
                for _, t in ipairs(getgc(true)) do
                    if type(t) == "table" then visit(t) end
                end
            end)
        end
        -- also walk the data returned by the game's loaded ModuleScripts (skins/inventory usually live there)
        if getloadedmodules then
            pcall(function()
                local budget = 60000
                local function walk(t, depth)
                    if seen[t] or depth > 5 or budget <= 0 then return end
                    visit(t)
                    seen[t] = true
                    local ok = pcall(function()
                        for _, v in next, t do
                            budget = budget - 1
                            if type(v) == "table" then walk(v, depth + 1) end
                        end
                    end)
                end
                for _, m in ipairs(getloadedmodules()) do
                    local name = m.Name:lower()
                    if name:find("skin") or name:find("inventor") or name:find("weapon") or name:find("cosmetic") or name:find("data") or name:find("item") or name:find("wrap") then
                        local ok, r = pcall(require, m)
                        if ok and type(r) == "table" then walk(r, 0) end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    local function eachBool(fn)
        for _, root in ipairs({ game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), localplayer }) do
            for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("BoolValue") then fn(d) end
            end
        end
    end

    local function unlockAll()
        local changed, inst = 0, 0
        local building = not hadOwned
        eachItem(function(t)
            local name = itemName(t)
            local did = false
            for _, k in ipairs(FLAGS_TRUE) do
                local v = rawget(t, k)
                if v ~= nil then
                    if building and v == true and name then saved.owned[name] = true end
                    if v == false then
                        snapT[t] = snapT[t] or {}
                        if snapT[t][k] == nil then snapT[t][k] = false end
                        rawset(t, k, true) did = true
                    end
                end
            end
            for _, k in ipairs(FLAGS_FALSE) do
                if rawget(t, k) == true then
                    snapT[t] = snapT[t] or {}
                    if snapT[t][k] == nil then snapT[t][k] = true end
                    rawset(t, k, false) did = true
                end
            end
            if did then changed = changed + 1 end
        end)
        eachBool(function(d)
            local n = d.Name:lower()
            for _, f in ipairs(FLAGS_TRUE) do
                if n == f:lower() and not d.Value then
                    if snapV[d] == nil then snapV[d] = false end
                    pcall(function() d.Value = true end) inst = inst + 1
                end
            end
            for _, f in ipairs(FLAGS_FALSE) do
                if n == f:lower() and d.Value then
                    if snapV[d] == nil then snapV[d] = true end
                    pcall(function() d.Value = false end) inst = inst + 1
                end
            end
        end)
        if building then hadOwned = true persist() end
        return changed, inst
    end

    local function restoreMine()
        local n = 0
        -- exact originals captured this session
        for t, flags in pairs(snapT) do
            for k, v in pairs(flags) do pcall(function() rawset(t, k, v) end) n = n + 1 end
        end
        for d, v in pairs(snapV) do pcall(function() if d.Parent then d.Value = v end end) n = n + 1 end
        table.clear(snapT) table.clear(snapV)
        -- items unlocked in an earlier session: use the saved list of skins you really owned
        if next(saved.owned) ~= nil then
            eachItem(function(t)
                local name = itemName(t)
                if not name then return end
                local owned = saved.owned[name] == true
                for _, k in ipairs(FLAGS_TRUE) do
                    if rawget(t, k) == true and not owned then rawset(t, k, false) n = n + 1 end
                end
                for _, k in ipairs(FLAGS_FALSE) do
                    if rawget(t, k) == false and not owned then rawset(t, k, true) n = n + 1 end
                end
            end)
        end
        return n
    end

    local SkinBox = MiscTab:AddRightGroupbox("Skin Tools")
    SkinBox:AddLabel("Best effort, client side only. Your original skins are remembered and put back when you switch this off.", true)
    SkinBox:AddButton({ Text = "Scan skin data", Func = function() task.spawn(scan) end })
    SkinBox:AddToggle("SkinUnlockAll", { Text = "Unlock all skins (stays on)", Default = false, Callback = function(v)
        saved.unlock = v
        persist()
        if v then
            if active then return end
            active = true
            task.spawn(function()
                while active and not Library.Unloaded do
                    local c, i = unlockAll()
                    task.wait(3)
                end
            end)
            local c, i = unlockAll()
            say("Unlock all", "ON: " .. c .. " item tables, " .. i .. " value objects. Saved; it stays on after you rejoin.")
        else
            active = false
            local n = restoreMine()
            say("Unlock all", "OFF: restored " .. n .. " values to what you owned.")
        end
    end })
    SkinBox:AddButton({ Text = "Forget saved skins (re-record on next unlock)", Func = function()
        saved.owned = {} hadOwned = false persist()
        say("Skin Tools", "Saved skin list cleared.")
    end })
    if saved.unlock then
        task.delay(2.5, function() pcall(function() Toggles.SkinUnlockAll:SetValue(true) end) end)
    end
end)
if not __mok then warn("[ethereal] skin tools error: " .. tostring(__merr)) end
end

local UtilBox = MiscTab:AddLeftGroupbox("Utilities")
Tgl(UtilBox, "AntiAfkE", "Anti AFK", "Prevents idle kick.", function(v) config.antiAfkEnabled = v if v then startAntiAfk() else stopAntiAfk() end end)
Tgl(UtilBox, "AutoCollectE", "Auto Collect", "Teleports to nearby heals.", function(v) config.autocollectEnabled = v if v then startAutocollect() else stopAutocollect() end end)

-- VISUALS
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local CoreGuiS = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local vis = { chams = false, names = false, team = true, dist = 1000, fov = false, fovV = 90, full = false, fog = false }
local espObjs, lightBackup = {}, nil
local function clearEsp(p)
    local o = espObjs[p]
    if o then
        pcall(function() if o.hl then o.hl:Destroy() end end)
        pcall(function() if o.bb then o.bb:Destroy() end end)
        espObjs[p] = nil
    end
end
local function updateEsp()
    local myHrp = getHrp()
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= localplayer then
            local ch = p.Character
            local hrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local ok = (vis.chams or vis.names) and hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0
            if ok and vis.team and localplayer.Team ~= nil and p.Team == localplayer.Team then ok = false end
            local d = (ok and myHrp) and (myHrp.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude or 0
            if ok and myHrp and d > vis.dist then ok = false end
            if not ok then
                clearEsp(p)
            else
                local o = espObjs[p] or {}
                espObjs[p] = o
                if vis.chams then
                    if not o.hl or o.hl.Adornee ~= ch then
                        pcall(function() if o.hl then o.hl:Destroy() end end)
                        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                        hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170); hl.FillTransparency = 0.6
                        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255); hl.OutlineTransparency = 0.2
                        hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                        hl.Adornee = ch; hl.Parent = CoreGuiS
                        o.hl = hl
                    end
                elseif o.hl then o.hl:Destroy(); o.hl = nil end
                if vis.names then
                    local head = ch:FindFirstChild("Head") or hrp
                    if not o.bb or o.bb.Adornee ~= head then
                        pcall(function() if o.bb then o.bb:Destroy() end end)
                        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                        bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 36); bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
                        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0); bb.Adornee = head; bb.Parent = CoreGuiS
                        local tl = Instance.new("TextLabel", bb)
                        tl.Name = "T"; tl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                        tl.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1); tl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
                        tl.Font = Enum.Font.Code; tl.TextSize = 13
                        o.bb = bb
                    end
                    local tl = o.bb:FindFirstChild("T")
                    if tl then tl.Text = string.format("%s\n%d hp | %d studs", p.DisplayName, hum.Health, d) end
                elseif o.bb then o.bb:Destroy(); o.bb = nil end
            end
        else
            clearEsp(p)
        end
    end
end
local espAcc = 0
table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    espAcc = espAcc + dt
    if espAcc >= 0.1 then
        espAcc = 0
        if vis.chams or vis.names then pcall(updateEsp) end
    end
end))
table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if vis.fov and workspace.CurrentCamera then workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = vis.fovV end
end))
table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(clearEsp))
local function applyLight()
    if vis.full or vis.fog then
        if not lightBackup then
            lightBackup = { Brightness = Lighting.Brightness, ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime, GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
                Ambient = Lighting.Ambient, OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient, FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd, FogStart = Lighting.FogStart }
        end
        if vis.full then
            Lighting.Brightness = 2; Lighting.ClockTime = 14; Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
            Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(178, 178, 178); Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(178, 178, 178)
        end
        if vis.fog then Lighting.FogEnd = 1e6; Lighting.FogStart = 1e6 end
    end
    if lightBackup and not vis.full then
        Lighting.Brightness = lightBackup.Brightness; Lighting.ClockTime = lightBackup.ClockTime
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = lightBackup.GlobalShadows; Lighting.Ambient = lightBackup.Ambient
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = lightBackup.OutdoorAmbient
    end
    if lightBackup and not vis.fog then Lighting.FogEnd = lightBackup.FogEnd; Lighting.FogStart = lightBackup.FogStart end
    if lightBackup and not vis.full and not vis.fog then lightBackup = nil end
end
getgenv().stopVisuals = function()
    vis.chams, vis.names, vis.fov, vis.full, vis.fog = false, false, false, false, false
    for p in pairs(espObjs) do clearEsp(p) end
    pcall(applyLight)
end

local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local animNames, soundNames, animIds, soundIds = {}, {}, {}, {}
for _, a in ipairs(ANIMS) do animNames[#animNames + 1] = a[1]; animIds[a[1]] = a[2] end
for _, s in ipairs(SOUNDS) do soundNames[#soundNames + 1] = s[1]; soundIds[s[1]] = s[2] end

local ex = { anim = "Worm Dance", loop = true, speed = 1, hitOn = false, killOn = false, hitName = "Neverlose", killName = "Killing Spree", vol = 1,
    hbOn = false, hbSize = 8, hbTrans = 0.7, hbTeam = true }
local animTrack
local function stopAnim() if animTrack then pcall(function() animTrack:Stop() end) animTrack = nil end end
local function playAnim()
    stopAnim()
    local ch = localplayer.Character
    local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", hum)
    local a = Instance.new("Animation")
    a.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(animIds[ex.anim]):gsub("%D", "")
    local ok, tr = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(a) end)
    if not ok or not tr then return Notify("Animation", "Couldn't load that animation.") end
    tr.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
    tr.Looped = ex.loop
    tr:Play()
    tr:AdjustSpeed(ex.speed)
    animTrack = tr
end
local function playSnd(name)
    local id = soundIds[name]
    if not id then return end
    local s = Instance.new("Sound")
    s.SoundId = id; s.Volume = ex.vol; s.Parent = SoundService
    s:Play()
    Debris:AddItem(s, 6)
end
getgenv().stopExtras = function()
    stopAnim()
    ex.hitOn, ex.killOn, ex.hbOn = false, false, false
end

-- hit / kill sounds (heuristic: enemy health drops soon after you click)
local lastClick = 0
table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, gp)
    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then lastClick = tick() end
end))
local watched = {}
local function watchPlayer(p)
    if p == localplayer or watched[p] then return end
    watched[p] = true
    local function hook(ch)
        local hum = ch:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
        if not hum then return end
        local last = hum.Health
        hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(h)
            local dropped = h < last
            last = h
            if dropped and (tick() - lastClick) < 0.5 then
                if h <= 0 and ex.killOn then playSnd(ex.killName)
                elseif h > 0 and ex.hitOn then playSnd(ex.hitName) end
            end
        end)
    end
    if p.Character then task.spawn(hook, p.Character) end
    p.CharacterAdded:Connect(hook)
end
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do watchPlayer(p) end
table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer))

-- hitbox expander
local hbOrig = {}
local function hbRestore(p)
    local o = hbOrig[p]
    if o and o.part and o.part.Parent then
        pcall(function() o.part.Size = o.size; o.part.Transparency = o.trans; o.part.CanCollide = o.coll end)
    end
    hbOrig[p] = nil
end
local hbAcc = 0
table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    hbAcc = hbAcc + dt
    if hbAcc < 0.1 then return end
    hbAcc = 0
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= localplayer then
            local ch = p.Character
            local hrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local skip = ex.hbTeam and localplayer.Team ~= nil and p.Team == localplayer.Team
            if ex.hbOn and hrp and not skip then
                if not hbOrig[p] or hbOrig[p].part ~= hrp then
                    hbRestore(p)
                    hbOrig[p] = { part = hrp, size = hrp.Size, trans = hrp.Transparency, coll = hrp.CanCollide }
                end
                hrp.Size = Vector3.new(ex.hbSize, ex.hbSize, ex.hbSize)
                hrp.Transparency = ex.hbTrans
                hrp.CanCollide = false
            elseif hbOrig[p] then
                hbRestore(p)
            end
        end
    end
end))

-- ESP PRO (Drawing API)
do
local __mok, __merr = pcall(function()
    local E = { hz = 60, fill = false, on = false, box = true, style = "Corner", name = true, dist = true, hp = true, tool = false, tracer = false, tracerFrom = "Bottom", skel = false, head = false, arrows = false, team = true, maxDist = 2500, size = 13, visCheck = true,
        colE = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90), colV = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 150), colT = Color3.fromRGB(90, 160, 255) }
    local objs = {}
    local hasDraw = Drawing ~= nil
    local R15 = { { "Head", "UpperTorso" }, { "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso" }, { "UpperTorso", "LeftUpperArm" }, { "LeftUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm" }, { "LeftLowerArm", "LeftHand" }, { "UpperTorso", "RightUpperArm" }, { "RightUpperArm", "RightLowerArm" }, { "RightLowerArm", "RightHand" }, { "LowerTorso", "LeftUpperLeg" }, { "LeftUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg" }, { "LeftLowerLeg", "LeftFoot" }, { "LowerTorso", "RightUpperLeg" }, { "RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg" }, { "RightLowerLeg", "RightFoot" } }
    local R6 = { { "Head", "Torso" }, { "Torso", "Left Arm" }, { "Torso", "Right Arm" }, { "Torso", "Left Leg" }, { "Torso", "Right Leg" } }
    local function mk(class, props)
        local d = Drawing.new(class)
        for k, v in pairs(props) do d[k] = v end
        return d
    end
    local function make()
        local o = { all = {}, corner = {}, cornerOut = {}, skel = {}, st = {}, mark = {} }
        local function reg(d) o.all[#o.all + 1] = d return d end
        o.boxOut = reg(mk("Square", { Thickness = 3, Filled = false, Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Visible = false }))
        o.fill = reg(mk("Square", { Filled = true, Transparency = 0.82, Visible = false }))
        o.box = reg(mk("Square", { Thickness = 1, Filled = false, Visible = false }))
        for i = 1, 8 do
            o.cornerOut[i] = reg(mk("Line", { Thickness = 3, Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Visible = false }))
            o.corner[i] = reg(mk("Line", { Thickness = 1, Visible = false }))
        end
        o.hpBg = reg(mk("Square", { Filled = true, Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Visible = false }))
        o.hp = reg(mk("Square", { Filled = true, Visible = false }))
        o.name = reg(mk("Text", { Center = true, Outline = true, Size = 13, Visible = false }))
        o.info = reg(mk("Text", { Center = true, Outline = true, Size = 12, Visible = false }))
        o.tracer = reg(mk("Line", { Thickness = 1, Visible = false }))
        o.head = reg(mk("Circle", { NumSides = 20, Thickness = 1, Filled = false, Visible = false }))
        for i = 1, 14 do o.skel[i] = reg(mk("Line", { Thickness = 1, Visible = false })) end
        o.arrow = reg(mk("Triangle", { Filled = true, Visible = false }))
        o.visT, o.vis = 0, true
        return o
    end
    local fr = 0
    local lastDraw = 0
    local function show(o, d)
        if not o.st[d] then d.Visible = true o.st[d] = true end
        o.mark[d] = fr
    end
    local function sweep(o)
        for _, d in ipairs(o.all) do
            if o.st[d] and o.mark[d] ~= fr then d.Visible = false o.st[d] = false end
        end
    end
    local function hide(o)
        for _, d in ipairs(o.all) do if o.st[d] then d.Visible = false o.st[d] = false end end
    end
    local function kill(o) for _, d in ipairs(o.all) do pcall(function() d:Remove() end) end end
    local function toScreen(cam, pos)
        local v, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(pos)
        return Vector2.new(v.X, v.Y), on and v.Z > 0, v.Z
    end
    local function draw()
        if not hasDraw then return end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return end
        local vp = cam.ViewportSize
        local camPos = cam.CFrame.Position
        if not E.on then
            for _, o in pairs(objs) do hide(o) end
            return
        end
        local now = tick()
        if now - lastDraw < 1 / E.hz then return end
        lastDraw = now
        fr = fr + 1
        for p, o in pairs(objs) do if not p.Parent then kill(o) objs[p] = nil end end
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= localplayer then
                local o = objs[p]
                if not o then o = make() objs[p] = o end
                local ch = p.Character
                local hrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local show = E.on and hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0
                local mate = localplayer.Team ~= nil and p.Team == localplayer.Team
                if show and mate and E.team then show = false end
                local dist = show and (camPos - hrp.Position).Magnitude or 0
                if show and dist > E.maxDist then show = false end
                if not show then
                    hide(o)
                else
                    if E.visCheck and now - o.visT > 0.12 then
                        o.visT = now
                        local rp = RaycastParams.new()
                        rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                        rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { localplayer.Character, ch }
                        o.vis = workspace:Raycast(camPos, hrp.Position - camPos, rp) == nil
                    end
                    local col = mate and E.colT or ((E.visCheck and o.vis) and E.colV or E.colE)
                    local isTarget = getgenv().EtherealRageTarget == p
                    if isTarget then col = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 90) end
                    local topP, onTop = toScreen(cam, hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0))
                    local botP, onBot = toScreen(cam, hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0))
                    local center, onC, zc = toScreen(cam, hrp.Position)
                    local on = onTop and onBot and onC
                    local h = math.abs(botP.Y - topP.Y)
                    local w = h * 0.55
                    local x, y = center.X - w / 2, topP.Y
                    -- hide the per-box parts first, then enable what applies
                    if on then
                        if E.fill then o.fill.Position = Vector2.new(x, y) o.fill.Size = Vector2.new(w, h) o.fill.Color = col show(o, o.fill) end
                        if E.box then
                            if E.style == "Full" then
                                o.boxOut.Position = Vector2.new(x, y) o.boxOut.Size = Vector2.new(w, h) show(o, o.boxOut)
                                o.box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y) o.box.Size = Vector2.new(w, h) o.box.Color = col show(o, o.box)
                            else
                                local lx, ly = w * 0.28, h * 0.2
                                local pts = {
                                    { Vector2.new(x, y), Vector2.new(x + lx, y) }, { Vector2.new(x, y), Vector2.new(x, y + ly) },
                                    { Vector2.new(x + w, y), Vector2.new(x + w - lx, y) }, { Vector2.new(x + w, y), Vector2.new(x + w, y + ly) },
                                    { Vector2.new(x, y + h), Vector2.new(x + lx, y + h) }, { Vector2.new(x, y + h), Vector2.new(x, y + h - ly) },
                                    { Vector2.new(x + w, y + h), Vector2.new(x + w - lx, y + h) }, { Vector2.new(x + w, y + h), Vector2.new(x + w, y + h - ly) },
                                }
                                for i = 1, 8 do
                                    o.cornerOut[i].From = pts[i][1] o.cornerOut[i].To = pts[i][2] show(o, o.cornerOut[i])
                                    o.corner[i].From = pts[i][1] o.corner[i].To = pts[i][2] o.corner[i].Color = col show(o, o.corner[i])
                                end
                            end
                        end

                            local f = math.clamp(hum.Health / math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
                            o.hpBg.Position = Vector2.new(x - 6, y - 1) o.hpBg.Size = Vector2.new(4, h + 2) show(o, o.hpBg)
                            o.hp.Position = Vector2.new(x - 5, y + h * (1 - f)) o.hp.Size = Vector2.new(2, h * f)
                            o.hp.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 120), f) show(o, o.hp)
                        end
                        if E.name then
                            o.name.Text = (isTarget and "[TARGET] " or "") .. (p.DisplayName ~= "" and p.DisplayName or p.Name)
                            o.name.Size = E.size o.name.Color = col
                            o.name.Position = Vector2.new(x + w / 2, y - E.size - 3) show(o, o.name)
                        end
                        if E.dist or E.tool then
                            local parts = {}
                            if E.dist then parts[#parts + 1] = math.floor(dist) .. "m" end
                            if E.tool then
                                local t = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
                                if t then parts[#parts + 1] = t.Name end
                            end
                            o.info.Text = table.concat(parts, " | ")
                            o.info.Size = math.max(E.size - 1, 9) o.info.Color = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)

                        end
                        if E.head then
                            local hd = ch:FindFirstChild("Head")
                            if hd then
                                local hp2, onH = toScreen(cam, hd.Position)
                                if onH then o.head.Position = hp2 o.head.Radius = math.max(h * 0.09, 2) o.head.Color = col show(o, o.head) end
                            end
                        end
                        if E.skel then
                            local list = ch:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") and R15 or R6
                            for i, pr in ipairs(list) do
                                local a, b = ch:FindFirstChild(pr[1]), ch:FindFirstChild(pr[2])
                                if a and b then
                                    local pa, oa = toScreen(cam, a.Position)
                                    local pb, ob = toScreen(cam, b.Position)
                                    if oa and ob then o.skel[i].From = pa o.skel[i].To = pb o.skel[i].Color = col show(o, o.skel[i]) end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if E.tracer and onC then
                        local from = E.tracerFrom == "Center" and Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)
                            or (E.tracerFrom == "Mouse" and UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() or Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y))
                        o.tracer.From = from o.tracer.To = Vector2.new(center.X, y + h) o.tracer.Color = col show(o, o.tracer)
                    end

                        local dir = Vector2.new(rel.X, -rel.Z)
                        if dir.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                            dir = dir.Unit
                            local c = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)
                            local r = vp.Y * 0.4
                            local tip = c + dir * (r + 14)
                            local base = c + dir * r
                            local perp = Vector2.new(-dir.Y, dir.X) * 9
                            o.arrow.PointA = tip o.arrow.PointB = base + perp o.arrow.PointC = base - perp
                            o.arrow.Color = col show(o, o.arrow)
                        end
                    end
                    sweep(o)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function() pcall(draw) end))
    pcall(function() Library:OnUnload(function() for _, o in pairs(objs) do kill(o) end objs = {} end) end)

    local EB = VisTab:AddLeftGroupbox("ESP Pro")
    Tgl(EB, "EspPro", "ESP Pro", hasDraw and "Boxes, health, names, skeleton, tracers." or "Your executor has no Drawing API: use Chams below instead.", function(v) E.on = v end)
    EB:AddToggle("EspProBox", { Text = "Boxes", Default = true, Callback = function(v) E.box = v end })
    EB:AddDropdown("EspProStyle", { Text = "Box style", Values = { "Corner", "Full" }, Default = 1, Callback = function(v) E.style = v end })

    EC:AddLabel("Visible enemy"):AddColorPicker("EspColV", { Default = E.colV, Callback = function(v) E.colV = v end })
    EC:AddLabel("Teammate"):AddColorPicker("EspColT", { Default = E.colT, Callback = function(v) E.colT = v end })

    -- custom crosshair
    local X = { on = false, size = 8, gap = 4, thick = 1, dot = false, col = Color3.fromRGB(212, 160, 90) }
    local xl = {}

    if hasDraw then
        for i = 1, 4 do xl[i] = mk("Line", { Visible = false }) end

    end
    table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not hasDraw then return end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return end
        local c = cam.ViewportSize / 2
        for i = 1, 4 do
            local l = xl[i]
            l.Visible = X.on l.Color = X.col l.Thickness = X.thick
            local dx, dy = (i == 1 and -1 or i == 2 and 1 or 0), (i == 3 and -1 or i == 4 and 1 or 0)

-- WEAPON SKIN (visual only, your screen)
do
local __mok, __merr = pcall(function()
    local W = { on = false, mat = "ForceField", col = Color3.fromRGB(212, 160, 90), rainbow = false, trans = 0, refl = 0, tex = "", hideArms = false, rate = 0.1 }
    local orig = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local sa = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local MATS = { "Plastic", "SmoothPlastic", "Neon", "ForceField", "Glass", "Metal", "DiamondPlate", "Foil", "Ice", "Marble", "Granite", "Slate" }

    local function weaponModels()
        local list = {}
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam then
            for _, c in ipairs(cam:GetChildren()) do
                if c:IsA("Model") or c:IsA("Folder") or c:IsA("Tool") then list[#list + 1] = c end
            end
        end
        local ch = localplayer.Character
        if ch then
            for _, c in ipairs(ch:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("Tool") then list[#list + 1] = c end end
        end
        return list
    end
    local function isArm(p)
        local n = p.Name:lower()
        return n:find("arm") or n:find("hand") or n:find("sleeve") or n:find("glove")
    end
    local function apply(p, col)
        if not p:IsA("BasePart") then return end
        local o = orig[p]
        if not o then
            o = { Material = p.Material, Color = p.Color, Transparency = p.Transparency, Reflectance = p.Reflectance }
            if p:IsA("MeshPart") then o.TextureID = p.TextureID end
            orig[p] = o
        end
        if isArm(p) and W.hideArms then p.Transparency = 1 return end
        if isArm(p) then return end
        pcall(function()
            p.Material = Enum.Material[W.mat]
            p.Color = col
            p.Transparency = W.trans
            p.Reflectance = W.refl
            if p:IsA("MeshPart") and W.tex ~= "" then
                local id = tostring(W.tex):gsub("%D", "")
                if id ~= "" then
                    for _, c in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
                        if c:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then sa[c] = p c.Parent = nil end
                    end
                    p.TextureID = "rbxassetid://" .. id
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    local function restore()
        for p, o in pairs(orig) do
            pcall(function()
                if p.Parent then
                    p.Material = o.Material p.Color = o.Color p.Transparency = o.Transparency p.Reflectance = o.Reflectance
                    if o.TextureID then p.TextureID = o.TextureID end
                end
            end)
        end
        for s, p in pairs(sa) do pcall(function() if p.Parent then s.Parent = p end end) end
        table.clear(orig) table.clear(sa)
    end

    local acc = 0
    table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not W.on then return end
        acc = acc + dt
        if acc < W.rate then return end
        acc = 0
        local col = W.rainbow and Color3.fromHSV((tick() * 0.25) % 1, 0.85, 1) or W.col
        for _, m in ipairs(weaponModels()) do
            for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do apply(d, col) end
            apply(m, col)
        end
    end))
    pcall(function() Library:OnUnload(function() W.on = false restore() end) end)

    local WB = VisTab:AddLeftGroupbox("Weapon Skin (visual)")
    WB:AddLabel("Only changes how your own weapon looks on your screen.", true)
    Tgl(WB, "WSkinOn", "Weapon skin", nil, function(v) W.on = v if not v then restore() end end)
    WB:AddDropdown("WSkinMat", { Text = "Material", Values = MATS, Default = 4, Callback = function(v) W.mat = v end })
    WB:AddLabel("Color"):AddColorPicker("WSkinCol", { Default = W.col, Callback = function(v) W.col = v end })
    Tgl(WB, "WSkinRb", "Rainbow", nil, function(v) W.rainbow = v end)
    Sld(WB, "WSkinTr", "Transparency", 0, 0, 0.9, 2, function(v) W.trans = v end)
    Sld(WB, "WSkinRf", "Reflectance", 0, 0, 1, 2, function(v) W.refl = v end)
    WB:AddInput("WSkinTex", { Text = "Texture asset ID (optional)", Default = "", Placeholder = "e.g. 123456789", Callback = function(v) W.tex = v restore() end })
    Tgl(WB, "WSkinArms", "Hide arms / gloves", nil, function(v) W.hideArms = v end)
end)
if not __mok then warn("[ethereal] weapon skin error: " .. tostring(__merr)) end
end

-- APPEARANCE (customise the menu)
do
    local AppBox = SettingsTab:AddLeftGroupbox("Appearance")
    local function recolor()
        Library.AccentColorDark = Library:GetDarkerColor(Library.AccentColor)
        pcall(function() Library:UpdateColorsUsingRegistry() end)
    end
    local names = Library:GetThemePresetNames()
    if #names > 0 then
        AppBox:AddDropdown("AppTheme", { Text = "Theme preset", Values = names, Default = (function() for i, n in ipairs(names) do if n == "Gold" then return i end end return 1 end)(), Callback = function(v) pcall(function() Library:ApplyThemePreset(v) end) end })
    end
    AppBox:AddLabel("Accent"):AddColorPicker("AppAccent", { Default = Library.AccentColor, Title = "Accent", Callback = function(c) Library.AccentColor = c recolor() end })
    AppBox:AddLabel("Menu background"):AddColorPicker("AppMain", { Default = Library.MainColor, Title = "Menu background", Callback = function(c) Library.MainColor = c recolor() end })
    AppBox:AddLabel("Outer background"):AddColorPicker("AppBg", { Default = Library.BackgroundColor, Title = "Outer background", Callback = function(c) Library.BackgroundColor = c recolor() end })
    AppBox:AddLabel("Outlines"):AddColorPicker("AppOutline", { Default = Library.OutlineColor, Title = "Outlines", Callback = function(c) Library.OutlineColor = c recolor() end })
    AppBox:AddLabel("Text"):AddColorPicker("AppText", { Default = Library.FontColor, Title = "Text", Callback = function(c) Library.FontColor = c recolor() end })
    local fontNames = {}
    for n in pairs(Library.FontFaces or {}) do fontNames[#fontNames + 1] = n end
    table.sort(fontNames)
    if #fontNames > 0 then
        AppBox:AddDropdown("AppFont", { Text = "Font", Values = fontNames, Default = 1, Callback = function(v) pcall(function() Library:SetFontFace(v) end) end })
    end
    AppBox:AddSlider("AppFontSize", { Text = "Text size", Default = 13, Min = 10, Max = 20, Rounding = 0, Callback = function(v) pcall(function() Library:SetFontSize(v) end) end })
    local W, H = 860, 520
    AppBox:AddSlider("AppW", { Text = "Menu width", Default = 860, Min = 620, Max = 1500, Rounding = 0, Callback = function(v) W = v Library.BaseSize = Vector2.new(W, H) pcall(function() Library:FitScreen() end) end })
    AppBox:AddSlider("AppH", { Text = "Menu height", Default = 520, Min = 380, Max = 900, Rounding = 0, Callback = function(v) H = v Library.BaseSize = Vector2.new(W, H) pcall(function() Library:FitScreen() end) end })
    pcall(function() Library:AddBlurSlider(AppBox) end)
    pcall(function() Library:AddDarkenSlider(AppBox) end)
end

local ProfBox = SettingsTab:AddLeftGroupbox("Profiles")
local profileName = ""
ProfBox:AddInput("ProfName", { Text = "Profile name", Default = "", Placeholder = "name", Callback = function(v) profileName = v or "" end })
ProfBox:AddDropdown("ProfList", { Text = "Saved profiles", Values = (#listProfiles() > 0 and listProfiles() or { "(none)" }), Default = 1 })
ProfBox:AddButton({ Text = "Save Profile", Func = function()
    local ok, msg = saveProfile(profileName ~= "" and profileName or (Options.ProfName and Options.ProfName.Value) or "")
    Notify("Profiles", msg)
    if ok and Options.ProfList then local l = listProfiles() Options.ProfList:SetValues(l) end
end })
ProfBox:AddButton({ Text = "Load Profile", Func = function()
    local sel = Options.ProfList and Options.ProfList.Value
    if not sel or sel == "(none)" then return Notify("Profiles", "Select a profile.") end
    local ok, msg = loadProfile(sel)
    Notify("Profiles", msg)
    if ok then
        for _, pair in ipairs({
            { "FlyMode", "flyEnabled" }, { "Noclip", "nc" }, { "DoubleJump", "doubleJumpEnabled" },
            { "AntiAim", "antiAimEnabled" }, { "SpinBypass", "spinEnabled" }, { "DaggerBypass", "daggerBypass" },
        }) do
            local t = Toggles[pair[1]]
            if t then pcall(function() t:SetValue(config[pair[2]]) end) end
        end
    end
end })
ProfBox:AddButton({ Text = "Delete Profile", Func = function()
    local sel = Options.ProfList and Options.ProfList.Value
    if not sel or sel == "(none)" then return end
    Notify("Profiles", select(2, deleteProfile(sel)))
    local l = listProfiles() Options.ProfList:SetValues(#l > 0 and l or { "(none)" })
end })

MenuBox:AddButton({ Text = "Reload images (hair + logo)", Func = function() pcall(function() Library:LoadAssets() end) end })
MenuBox:AddToggle("VercelLockUI", { Text = "Lock UI (stop dragging)", Default = false, Callback = function(v) Library.LockUI = v end })

Sld(MenuBox, "MenuScale", "Menu scale (0 = auto)", 0, 0, 1.4, 2, function(v)
    Library.ScaleOverride = v > 0.3 and v or nil
    pcall(function() Library:FitScreen() end)
end)
Tgl(MenuBox, "PerfMode", "Performance mode", "ESP at 30 Hz and fewer visibility checks.", function(v)
    pcall(function() if Options.EspHz then Options.EspHz:SetValue(v and 30 or 60) end end)
end)
do
    local wm = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    wm.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25 wm.BackgroundColor3 = Library.BackgroundColor wm.BorderSizePixel = 0
    wm.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium wm.TextSize = 12 wm.TextColor3 = Library.AccentColor wm.Text = "ethereal"
    wm.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 22) wm.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10) wm.Visible = false wm.ZIndex = 45
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner") c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) c.Parent = wm
    wm.Parent = Library.ScreenGui
    local acc, frames, fps = 0, 0, 60
    table.insert(getgenv().AllConnections, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not wm.Visible then return end
        acc = acc + dt frames = frames + 1
        if acc >= 0.5 then
            fps = math.floor(frames / acc + 0.5) acc, frames = 0, 0
            local ping = 0
            pcall(function() ping = math.floor(game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()) end)
            wm.Text = "ethereal  |  " .. fps .. " fps  |  " .. ping .. " ms"
        end
    end))
    pcall(function() Library:OnUnload(function() wm:Destroy() end) end)
    local al = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    al.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35 al.BackgroundColor3 = Library.BackgroundColor al.BorderSizePixel = 0
    al.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium al.TextSize = 12 al.TextColor3 = Library.FontColor al.Text = ""
    al.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY al.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) al.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0) al.Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.34, 0)
    al.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right al.Visible = false al.ZIndex = 45
    local alp = Instance.new("UIPadding") alp.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8) alp.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8) alp.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5) alp.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 5) alp.Parent = al
    local alc = Instance.new("UICorner") alc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) alc.Parent = al
    al.Parent = Library.ScreenGui
    local skip = { VercelLockUI = true, Watermark = true, ActiveList = true, PerfMode = true }
    task.spawn(function()
        while not Library.Unloaded do
            task.wait(0.5)
            if al.Visible then
                local lines = {}
                for id, t in pairs(Toggles) do
                    if t.Value and not skip[id] and t.Text then lines[#lines + 1] = t.Text end
                end
                table.sort(lines)
                al.Text = #lines > 0 and table.concat(lines, "\n") or "nothing active"
            end
        end
    end)
    pcall(function() Library:OnUnload(function() al:Destroy() end) end)
    MenuBox:AddToggle("ActiveList", { Text = "Active features list", Default = false, Callback = function(v) al.Visible = v end })
    MenuBox:AddToggle("Watermark", { Text = "FPS / ping watermark", Default = false, Callback = function(v) wm.Visible = v end })
end
MenuBox:AddDropdown("MenuKey", { Text = "Menu key", Values = { "RightShift", "RightControl", "LeftAlt", "Insert", "Delete", "End", "Home", "F1", "F4", "K" }, Default = 1, Callback = function(v)
    Library.ToggleKeybind = { Type = "KeyPicker", Value = v }
    if Library.KeyHint then Library.KeyHint.Text = v .. "  \194\183  toggle menu" end
end })
MenuBox:AddLabel("Drag the top bar to move the menu.", true)
MenuBox:AddButton({ Text = "Save Global Config", Func = function() saveGlobalConfig() Notify("Config", "Saved.") end })
MenuBox:AddButton({ Text = "Panic (stop everything)", Func = function() getgenv().vercelPanic() end })
MenuBox:AddButton({ Text = "Unload", Func = function() getgenv().vercelPanic() Library:Unload() end })

getgenv().vercelPanic = function()
    for _, n in ipairs({ "Fly","Void","VoidSpam","Orbit","Tp","FakePosition","Desync","Evasion","Blink","Ghost","Glide",
        "RiotAbuser","RiotBypass","SlingRage","AntiProj","AntiClose","Wallbang","RapidFire","Autocollect","ReturnHome",
        "SafeZone","TeleportLoop","AntiAfk","UnderMap","Visuals","Extras","AntiMelee","Lilac","UE" }) do
        local f = getgenv()["stop" .. n]
        if f then pcall(f) end
    end
    for k, v in pairs(config) do if type(v) == "boolean" then config[k] = false end end
    config.voidAxisX, config.voidAxisY, config.voidAxisZ = true, true, true
end
pcall(function() Library:OnUnload(function()
    pcall(getgenv().vercelPanic)
    for _, c in ipairs(getgenv().AllConnections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    getgenv().vercel_loaded = nil
end) end)

getgenv().vercel_unload = function()
    pcall(getgenv().vercelPanic)
    pcall(function() Library:Unload() end)
end
MainTab:ShowTab()
Library:Notify("ethereal loaded", 3)
warn("[ethereal] ready")
end, function(e) return debug.traceback(tostring(e), 2) end)
if not __ok then
    getgenv().vercel_loaded = nil
    warn("[ethereal] FAILED: " .. tostring(__err))
end
